youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「吃火鍋」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是冬夜的火鍋店：門口取四十二號號碼牌、坐進角落的軟椅、選一半麻辣一半菌菇清湯的鴛鴦鍋、在點菜單上勾牛肉片與丸子、自己調兩碗不一樣的蘸料、問清楚十二秒與八分鐘的火候、請店家沿鍋邊加湯、手指燙到用冰塊和紗布處理、最後按鍋結帳、帶兩包冬粉回家。800 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含排隊等位、點食物、請人幫忙、結帳離開。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Sharing a Hot Pot Meal' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene is a hot pot restaurant on a cold night: taking ticket number forty-two at the door, settling into the corner seat, choosing a split pot with mala on one side and mushroom broth on the other, ticking beef slices and fish balls on the order sheet, mixing two different dipping bowls, checking the twelve-second and eight-minute cooking card, asking the staff to pour more broth along the rim, cooling a scalded finger with ice and a gauze pad, then paying per pot and taking two packs of vermicelli home. 800 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hot pot place looks packed tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɑt pɑt pleɪs lʊks pækt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 火鍋店今晚看起來客滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's grab a number at the front desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ɡræb ə ˈnʌmbər æt ðə frʌnt dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 我們先去櫃台拿個號碼牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, a table for two at eight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi ə ˈteɪbəl fɔr tu æt eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，八點兩位還有位子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your ticket is forty-two, right over here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈtɪkɪt ɪz ˈfɔrti tu raɪt ˈoʊvər hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 您的號碼牌是四十二號，就在這邊等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we wait on this bench by the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi weɪt ɑn ðɪs bɛntʃ baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我們就在門邊這張長椅上等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the tea is free while you wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ti ɪz fri waɪl ju weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，等位的時候茶水是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we really have forty tables ahead?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈrɪli hæv ˈfɔrti ˈteɪbəlz əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 我們前面真的有四十桌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not really, we are next after the big group.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈrɪli wi ɑr nɛkst ˈæftər ðə bɪɡ ɡrup/
dialogue.zh: 沒那麼多，那一大家子之後就輪到我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your phone number for a text, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr foʊn ˈnʌmbər fɔr ə tɛkst pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 請留一組手機號碼，好傳訊息通知。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, and thank you kindly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz ænd θæŋk ju ˈkaɪndli/
dialogue.zh: 給你，真是麻煩你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These benches are cold, take my jacket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ˈbɛntʃəz ɑr koʊld teɪk maɪ ˈdʒækɪt/
dialogue.zh: 長椅好冰，你先披我的外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, but the steam will ruin it.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju bʌt ðə stim wɪl ˈruɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，可是火鍋的蒸汽會把它弄壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do we wait, about twenty minutes?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du wi weɪt əˈbaʊt ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 還要等多久，大約二十分鐘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roughly, enough time to read the menu.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrʌfli ɪˈnʌf taɪm tu rid ðə ˈmɛnju/
dialogue.zh: 差不多，剛好夠我們把菜單看一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the broth photos make me hungry.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə brɔθ ˈfoʊtoʊz meɪk mi ˈhʌŋɡri/
dialogue.zh: 你看，這些鍋底的照片看得我好餓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mushroom broth here is very gentle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmʌʃrʊm brɔθ hɪr ɪz ˈvɛri ˈdʒɛntəl/
dialogue.zh: 這個店的菌菇鍋底特別溫和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this place famous for the mala pot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs pleɪs ˈfeɪməs fɔr ðə ˈmɑlə pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 這家店是以麻辣鍋出名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but they make a mild version too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ðeɪ meɪk ə maɪld ˈvɜrʒən tu/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，不過他們也有不辣的版本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope our table has a window seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp ˈaʊər ˈteɪbəl hæz ə ˈwɪndoʊ sit/
dialogue.zh: 我希望我們的位子可以靠窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The corner table by the plants is nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔrnər ˈteɪbəl baɪ ðə plænts ɪz naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 植物旁邊那張角落桌很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ticket forty-two just blinked on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɪkɪt ˈfɔrti tu dʒʌst blɪŋkt ɑn ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 四十二號剛剛在牆上亮了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is us, let's carry our water over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ʌs lɛts ˈkæri ˈaʊər ˈwɔtər ˈoʊvər/
dialogue.zh: 是我們了，端著水杯過去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This table seats four, just right for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈteɪbəl sits fɔr dʒʌst raɪt fɔr ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 這張四人桌剛好給我們兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit by the window, the air is fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ði ɛr ɪz frɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 坐窗邊吧，那裡的空氣比較清爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, the pot sits right in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðə pɑt sɪts raɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/
dialogue.zh: 你看，鍋子就嵌在桌子正中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the knob turns the flame down.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðə nɑb tɜrnz ðə fleɪm daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 對啊，旋鈕可以把火轉小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here are the wet wipes for your hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɑr ðə wɛt waɪps fɔr jɔr hændz/
dialogue.zh: 這是給你們擦手的濕巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, before we touch any raw beef.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt bɪˈfɔr wi tʌtʃ ˈɛni rɔ bif/
dialogue.zh: 正好，在碰到生牛肉片之前先擦手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I bring you the pot menu now?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ brɪŋ ju ðə pɑt ˈmɛnju naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在可以給你們鍋底菜單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes please, we are ready to choose.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliːz wi ɑr ˈrɛdi tu tʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 好，我們準備好要選鍋底了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Broth smells drift all the way down here.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɔθ smɛlz drɪft ɔl ðə weɪ daʊn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 湯頭的香氣一路飄到我們這一桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That smell is the best part of hot pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt smɛl ɪz ðə bɛst pɑrt əv hɑt pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 那種味道才是吃火鍋最好的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two barley teas, and one is for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈbɑrli tiz ænd wʌn ɪz fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 兩杯麥茶，這一杯是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I always order the barley tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju aɪ ˈɔlweɪz ˈɔrdər ðə ˈbɑrli ti/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我每次來都點麥茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I put my coat under the chair?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ pʊt maɪ koʊt ˈʌndər ðə tʃɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我的外套可以放在椅子下面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rack by the door has more room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ræk baɪ ðə dɔr hæz mɔr rum/
dialogue.zh: 門邊的衣架還有空間，掛那裡吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is a hair tie, if you need one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ə hɛr taɪ ɪf ju nid wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這有一根髮圈，需要的話就拿去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How sweet, steam gets in my hair.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ swit stim ɡɛts ɪn maɪ hɛr/
dialogue.zh: 你好貼心，蒸汽都會捲到我的頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our pot comes in five minutes, she said.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər pɑt kʌmz ɪn faɪv ˈmɪnɪts ʃi sɛd/
dialogue.zh: 她說我們的鍋五分鐘就上來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us sip tea and lean back a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs sɪp ti ænd lin bæk ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們先喝口茶，往後靠一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you remember the first hot pot here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju rɪˈmɛmbər ðə fɜrst hɑt pɑt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你還記得第一次來這裡吃火鍋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You spilled sesame sauce on your sleeve.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju spɪld ˈsɛsəmi sɔs ɑn jɔr sliv/
dialogue.zh: 你把芝麻醬全部噴在袖子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We laughed for ten minutes that night.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi læft fɔr tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ðæt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那晚我們笑了整整十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why I carry an old shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ aɪ ˈkæri ən oʊld ʃɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 所以我都會帶一件舊襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cloth here is already a little damp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs klɔθ hɪr ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ə ˈlɪtəl dæmp/
dialogue.zh: 我們桌上的布已經有點潮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A fresh one is on the way, look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə frɛʃ wʌn ɪz ɑn ðə weɪ lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 新的一塊馬上就送來了，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chopsticks arrived wrapped in clear paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɑpstɪks əˈraɪvd ræpt ɪn klɪr ˈpeɪpər/
dialogue.zh: 筷子是用透明紙包著送來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peel the wrapper and keep it on the rim.
dialogue.phonetic: /pil ðə ˈræpər ænd kip ɪt ɑn ðə rɪm/
dialogue.zh: 把包裝紙剝開，墊在碗邊就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long spoons are here, good for the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ spunz ɑr hɪr ɡʊd fɔr ðə pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 長湯匙也擺好了，很好撈鍋底的料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a paper apron waits on your chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə ˈpeɪpər ˈeɪprən weɪts ɑn jɔr tʃɛr/
dialogue.zh: 一條紙圍裙正掛在你的椅背上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, the music in here is soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən ðə ˈmjuzɪk ɪn hɪr ɪz sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 你聽，這裡的音樂好輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is my favorite kind of dinner noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt kaɪnd əv ˈdɪnər nɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡這種輕輕的晚餐聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cushion is thick and warm, sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈkʊʃən ɪz θɪk ænd wɔrm sɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 這個坐墊又厚又暖，坐下來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for a slow night of hot pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt fɔr ə sloʊ naɪt əv hɑt pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 正適合慢慢吃一鍋火鍋的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They leave the timer on the table for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ liv ðə ˈtaɪmər ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl fɔr ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 他們會在桌上留一個小計時器給我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, beef slices need only twelve seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd bif ˈslaɪsəz nid ˈoʊnli twɛlv ˈsɛkəndz/
dialogue.zh: 正好，牛肉片只要燙十二秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve seconds, I will count in my head.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈsɛkəndz aɪ wɪl kaʊnt ɪn maɪ hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 十二秒，我在心裡慢慢數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count softly, I will watch the steam too.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ˈsɔftli aɪ wɪl wɑtʃ ðə stim tu/
dialogue.zh: 你小聲數，我也一起看著蒸汽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Metal rim already warm under my fingers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛtəl rɪm ɔlˈrɛdi wɔrm ˈʌndər maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz/
dialogue.zh: 鍋緣的金屬邊摸起來已經溫溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon it fills, then we can start.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun ɪt fɪlz ðɛn wi kæn stɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 一下就會倒滿湯，然後我們開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our teapot is still half full, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈtiˌpɑt ɪz stɪl hæf fʊl si/
dialogue.zh: 我們的茶壺還剩半壺呢，看到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will ask them for another small cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æsk ðɛm fɔr əˈnʌðər smɔl kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我去請他們再拿一個小茶杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our next table is peeling shrimp already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər nɛkst ˈteɪbəl ɪz ˈpilɪŋ ʃrɪmp ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 隔壁桌已經在剝蝦子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can peel ours together, it is fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn pil ˈaʊərz təˈɡɛðər ɪt ɪz fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我們的可以一起剝，那樣很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little music, a little steam, perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ˈmjuzɪk ə ˈlɪtəl stim ˈpɜrfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 一點音樂、一點蒸汽，剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lamp above us is warm and low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp əˈbʌv ʌs ɪz wɔrm ænd loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們頭上那盞燈黃黃暗暗的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel calmer already, and you?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ˈkɑmər ɔlˈrɛdi ænd ju/
dialogue.zh: 我已經覺得比較放鬆了，你呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleepy in a nice way, from the smell.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslipi ɪn ə naɪs weɪ frʌm ðə smɛl/
dialogue.zh: 聞著那個味道就有點睏了，剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you book this for a quiet Friday?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju bʊk ðɪs fɔr ə ˈkwaɪət ˈfraɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你是為了安靜的星期五才訂位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I asked for two seats, nothing fancy.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æskt fɔr tu sits ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈfænsi/
dialogue.zh: 我只訂了兩個位子，很簡單的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She remembered your name, that felt nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi rɪˈmɛmbərd jɔr neɪm ðæt fɛlt naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 外場還記得你的名字，感覺真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She calls me Old Friend every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kɔlz mi oʊld frɛnd ˈɛvri taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 她每次都笑著叫我老朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Menu says the split pot comes in minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛnju sɛz ðə splɪt pɑt kʌmz ɪn ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 菜單上寫鴛鴦鍋幾分鐘就上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing comes until we choose the base.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ kʌmz ʌnˈtɪl wi tʃuz ðə beɪs/
dialogue.zh: 還沒選好鍋底，東西不會送上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your sleeves rolled up, you look ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr slivz roʊld ʌp ju lʊk ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 你袖子都捲起來了，看起來準備很足。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready for a long, slow, happy meal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi fɔr ə lɔŋ sloʊ ˈhæpi mil/
dialogue.zh: 準備好慢慢吃一頓開心的火鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want the burner on low first?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt ðə ˈbɜrnər ɑn loʊ fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 爐子先開小火比較好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, low heat keeps the broth gentle.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs loʊ hit kips ðə brɔθ ˈdʒɛntəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，小火可以讓湯頭溫柔一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small flame, like a candle in the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl fleɪm laɪk ə ˈkændəl ɪn ðə dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 火苗很小，像暗處的一根蠟燭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A candle that will feed us all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkændəl ðæt wɪl fid ʌs ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一根可以陪我們吃一整晚的蠟燭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone dropped a spoon in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn drɑpt ə spun ɪn ðə hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 走廊那裡有人掉了一支湯匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet place, we can hear other pots hum.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət pleɪs wi kæn hɪr ˈʌðər pɑts hʌm/
dialogue.zh: 店裡好安靜，連別桌的鍋都在低鳴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That hum is the best white noise ever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hʌm ɪz ðə bɛst waɪt nɔɪz ˈɛvər/
dialogue.zh: 那種低鳴就是最好的白噪音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So let us listen while the pot is new.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ lɛt ʌs ˈlɪsən waɪl ðə pɑt ɪz nu/
dialogue.zh: 所以趁鍋子還清，我們好好聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands feel warm now, no more cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz fil wɔrm naʊ noʊ mɔr koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 我的手現在是暖的，不冷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, the tea helped a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu ðə ti hɛlpt ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，喝了熱茶就有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the sauce bar glows across the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə sɔs bɑr ɡloʊz əˈkrɔs ðə rum/
dialogue.zh: 你看，調料台在那一頭亮著燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will go there after the broth boils.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl ɡoʊ ðɛr ˈæftər ðə brɔθ bɔɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 等湯滾了我們再去調蘸料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the sauce bar far from our table?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə sɔs bɑr fɑr frʌm ˈaʊər ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 調料台離我們這張桌遠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight steps, past the big fish tank.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt stɛps pæst ðə bɪɡ fɪʃ tæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 八步而已，經過那個大魚缸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our number light is off, so we stay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈnʌmbər laɪt ɪz ɔf soʊ wi steɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們的號碼燈熄了，所以坐穩就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have the whole corner now, hooray.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv ðə hoʊl ˈkɔrnər naʊ huˈreɪ/
dialogue.zh: 現在整個角落都是我們的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we share one pot or two small?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃæl wi ʃɛr wʌn pɑt ɔr tu smɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我們共吃一鍋，還是點兩鍋小的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One big split pot, like every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bɪɡ splɪt pɑt laɪk ˈɛvri taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 一鍋大的鴛鴦鍋，像我們每次那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Split pots are our little tradition.
dialogue.phonetic: /splɪt pɑts ɑr ˈaʊər ˈlɪtəl trəˈdɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 鴛鴦鍋是我們兩個的小傳統。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tradition, ritual, and a very good dinner.
dialogue.phonetic: /trəˈdɪʃən ˈrɪtʃuəl ænd ə ˈvɛri ɡʊd ˈdɪnər/
dialogue.zh: 是傳統、是儀式，也是很棒的一餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am glad we waited for this table.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ɡlæd wi ˈweɪtəd fɔr ðɪs ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 很高興我們願意等這張桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, the wait made it taste better.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu ðə weɪt meɪd ɪt teɪst ˈbɛtər/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，等過之後吃起來更好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To a quiet hot pot night together.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ə ˈkwaɪət hɑt pɑt naɪt təˈɡɛðər/
dialogue.zh: 敬我們安靜的一鍋夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheers, and we stay till the last ladle.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪrz ænd wi steɪ tɪl ðə læst ˈlædəl/
dialogue.zh: 乾杯，我們喝到最後一杓湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which pot bases do you have tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ pɑt ˈbeɪsəz du ju hæv təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你們今晚一共有哪幾種鍋底？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mala, tomato, mushroom, and a milk base.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɑlə təˈmeɪtoʊ ˈmʌʃrʊm ænd ə mɪlk beɪs/
dialogue.zh: 麻辣、番茄、菌菇，還有牛奶鍋底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will take the split pot again.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl teɪk ðə splɪt pɑt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我們還要點鴛鴦鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One side mala, one side clear?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn saɪd ˈmɑlə wʌn saɪd klɪr/
dialogue.zh: 一邊麻辣，一邊清淡是嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tomato base smells a little sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə təˈmeɪtoʊ beɪs smɛlz ə ˈlɪtəl ʃɑrp/
dialogue.zh: 番茄鍋底聞起來有一點嗆鼻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So let's take mushroom, it stays so mild.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ lɛts teɪk ˈmʌʃrʊm ɪt steɪz soʊ maɪld/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們選菌菇，它一點都不辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How spicy is the mala side, honestly?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈspaɪsi ɪz ðə ˈmɑlə saɪd ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，麻辣那邊到底有多辣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium heat, we can stay at level three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidiəm hit wi kæn steɪ æt ˈlɛvəl θri/
dialogue.zh: 中辣就好，我們可以停在三級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Level three sounds brave for a Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛvəl θri saʊndz breɪv fɔr ə ˈfraɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 星期五就吃三級辣，真夠大膽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can slow down after each plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn sloʊ daʊn ˈæftər itʃ pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 吃完一盤，我們就可以慢下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please add ginger and scallion to the clear side.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz æd ˈdʒɪndʒər ænd ˈskæliən tu ðə klɪr saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 請在清湯那邊加薑片和蔥段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ginger, scallion, and one piece of corn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɪndʒər ˈskæliən ænd wʌn pis əv kɔrn/
dialogue.zh: 薑、蔥，再來一塊玉米。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the mushroom broth made fresh here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈmʌʃrʊm brɔθ meɪd frɛʃ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 菌菇湯頭是在店內現熬的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh mushrooms, cooked here since noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ ˈmʌʃrʊmz kʊkt hɪr sɪns nun/
dialogue.zh: 新鮮菇類，從中午就在店裡熬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mushroom broth smells like a quiet forest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌʃrʊm brɔθ smɛlz laɪk ə ˈkwaɪət ˈfɔrəst/
dialogue.zh: 菌菇湯聞起來像一座安靜的森林。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why I always pick this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ aɪ ˈɔlweɪz pɪk ðɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 所以我每次來都選這個鍋底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No oil on the clear side, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɔɪl ɑn ðə klɪr saɪd raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 清湯那邊幾乎沒有油，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a thin film, we can lift that off.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə θɪn fɪlm wi kæn lɪft ðæt ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 只有一點油膜，我們可以把它撇掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This divider keeps both soups apart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs dɪˈvaɪdər kips boʊθ sups əˈpɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 中間這片隔板把兩種湯分開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, so the noodles stay on one side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd soʊ ðə ˈnudəlz steɪ ɑn wʌn saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 正好，冬粉就不會跑到另一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the mala side come with chilies?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈmɑlə saɪd kʌm wɪð ˈtʃɪliz/
dialogue.zh: 麻辣鍋底會放辣椒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus a spoon of broad bean paste.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌs ə spun əv brɔd bin peɪst/
dialogue.zh: 會，另外還加一匙豆瓣醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Numbing taste is what I came for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbɪŋ teɪst ɪz wʌt aɪ keɪm fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我就是為了那種麻的感覺而來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, though my tongue feels funny.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu ðoʊ maɪ tʌŋ filz ˈfʌni/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，不過舌頭會麻麻怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this pot too numbing for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs pɑt tu ˈnʌmbɪŋ fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 這鍋麻辣的程度對你會不會太凶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, one sip of mushroom broth settles it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wʌn sɪp əv ˈmʌʃrʊm brɔθ ˈsɛtəlz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不會，喝一口菌菇湯就穩下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pepper oil floats in small circles here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛpər ɔɪl floʊts ɪn smɔl ˈsɜrkəlz hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 花椒油在湯面浮成一個個小圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks like a tiny night sky.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks laɪk ə ˈtaɪni naɪt skaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 看起來就像一小片夜空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the heat up, the clear side barely moves.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ði hit ʌp ðə klɪr saɪd ˈbɛrli muvz/
dialogue.zh: 把火轉大一點，清湯那邊幾乎都沒動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more minute, then it starts to bubble.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈmɪnɪt ðɛn ɪt stɑrts tu ˈbʌbəl/
dialogue.zh: 再過一分鐘，它就會開始冒泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we cover the pot while it heats?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈkʌvər ðə pɑt waɪl ɪt hits/
dialogue.zh: 湯熱的時候我們要蓋鍋蓋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half cover, so the steam stays inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ˈkʌvər soʊ ðə stim steɪz ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 蓋一半就好，讓蒸汽留在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lid handle feels warm, use the cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪd ˈhændəl filz wɔrm juz ðə klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 鍋蓋把手有點燙，用布墊著拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cloth is clean, I took a fresh one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɔθ ɪz klin aɪ tʊk ə frɛʃ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這塊是乾淨的，我拿了一條新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mushroom for the first bowl, yes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌʃrʊm fɔr ðə fɜrst boʊl jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 第一碗先喝菌菇湯，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half a bowl, slow and very warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə boʊl sloʊ ænd ˈvɛri wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 喝半碗就好，慢慢的、熱熱的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the ladle is heavier than it looks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl ðə ˈlædəl ɪz ˈhɛviər ðæn ɪt lʊks/
dialogue.zh: 小心，那支湯杓比看起來還重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will pour twice, a little each time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pɔr twaɪs ə ˈlɪtəl itʃ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我分兩次倒，每次只倒一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First sip is sweet, like a fall day.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst sɪp ɪz swit laɪk ə fɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 第一口甜甜的，像秋天的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Autumn in a bowl, with a little salt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔtəm ɪn ə boʊl wɪð ə ˈlɪtəl sɔlt/
dialogue.zh: 碗裡的秋天，還帶一點鹹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Salt level feels right on the tongue.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔlt ˈlɛvəl filz raɪt ɑn ðə tʌŋ/
dialogue.zh: 鹹度在舌頭上剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kitchen was gentle with salt today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɪtʃən wʌz ˈdʒɛntəl wɪð sɔlt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 廚房今天下鹽下手很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like the milk base next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju laɪk ðə mɪlk beɪs nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 下次你想試試牛奶鍋底嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with corn and a little carrot.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪð kɔrn ænd ə ˈlɪtəl ˈkærət/
dialogue.zh: 好，加玉米和一點紅蘿蔔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mushroom side gets deeper as it boils.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌʃrʊm saɪd ɡɛts ˈdipər æz ɪt bɔɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 菌菇那邊越煮味道越濃厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we keep the heat low there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kip ði hit loʊ ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那邊的火我們就留小一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spicy side needs a stronger boil.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspaɪsi saɪd nidz ə ˈstrɔŋɡər bɔɪl/
dialogue.zh: 麻辣那邊要煮得比較滾才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we raise that knob, not this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi reɪz ðæt nɑb nɑt ðɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那我們轉那邊的旋鈕，不轉這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the mala is dancing now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə ˈmɑlə ɪz ˈdænsɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你看，麻辣那邊翻滾起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Little bubbles, and the room smells warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪtəl ˈbʌbəlz ænd ðə rum smɛlz wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 小泡泡輕輕滾，整個房間聞起來暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the oil layer too thick for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ɔɪl ˈleɪər tu θɪk fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 那層浮油對你來說會不會太厚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, we can ask for less oil.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl wi kæn æsk fɔr lɛs ɔɪl/
dialogue.zh: 有一點，我們可以請他們少放油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She said one spoon less, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛd wʌn spun lɛs noʊ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 她說少一匙沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, and keep the scallion pieces long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ænd kip ðə ˈskæliən ˈpisəz lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 正好，蔥段記得留長一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our broth came with two dried chilies.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər brɔθ keɪm wɪð tu draɪd ˈtʃɪliz/
dialogue.zh: 我們的湯裡放了兩段乾辣椒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will lift them out, one at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl lɪft ðɛm aʊt wʌn æt ə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我一支一支把它們撈出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you fish the chilies or do I?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju fɪʃ ðə ˈtʃɪliz ɔr du aɪ/
dialogue.zh: 辣椒換你撈，還是我撈？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You fish them, my hands are full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju fɪʃ ðɛm maɪ hændz ɑr fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 換你撈辣椒，我兩手都滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Corn on the clear side, it sweetens.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔrn ɑn ðə klɪr saɪd ɪt ˈswitənz/
dialogue.zh: 玉米放清湯那邊，會越煮越甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the broth tastes like a summer field.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə brɔθ teɪsts laɪk ə ˈsʌmər fild/
dialogue.zh: 那湯喝起來就會像夏天的田。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Summer fields in a pot, that is nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmər fildz ɪn ə pɑt ðæt ɪz naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 鍋子裡裝著夏天的田野，真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice and quiet, the steam does the talking.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ænd ˈkwaɪət ðə stim dʌz ðə ˈtɔkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 美好又安靜，蒸汽負責說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody needs to fill this silence.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbədi nidz tu fɪl ðɪs ˈsaɪləns/
dialogue.zh: 沒有人需要打破這份安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the pot, talking in small bubbles.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə pɑt ˈtɔkɪŋ ɪn smɔl ˈbʌbəlz/
dialogue.zh: 只有鍋子用小泡泡在說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two bases in one pot, is that allowed?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈbeɪsəz ɪn wʌn pɑt ɪz ðæt əˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 一鍋放兩種鍋底，這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the split pot costs a little more.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə splɪt pɑt kɔsts ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 可以，鴛鴦鍋會多一點錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is fair, two soups take more work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz fɛr tu sups teɪk mɔr wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 很合理，兩種湯要多費功夫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two soups, and we just sit and wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu sups ænd wi dʒʌst sɪt ænd weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 兩種湯，而我們只要坐著等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The broth is rising, look at it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə brɔθ ɪz ˈraɪzɪŋ lʊk æt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 湯越升越高了，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost full, the divider holds both sides.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst fʊl ðə dɪˈvaɪdər hoʊldz boʊθ saɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 快滿了，隔板撐住兩邊的湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the clear side really only mushrooms?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə klɪr saɪd ˈrɪli ˈoʊnli ˈmʌʃrʊmz/
dialogue.zh: 清淡那邊真的只有菇類嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three kinds, plus a piece of winter melon.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri kaɪndz plʌs ə pis əv ˈwɪntər ˈmɛlən/
dialogue.zh: 有三種菇，外加一塊冬瓜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Winter melon in soup is a small gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪntər ˈmɛlən ɪn sup ɪz ə smɔl ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 湯裡的冬瓜像一份小小的禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quiet gift, sweet at the edges.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkwaɪət ɡɪft swit æt ði ˈɛdʒɪz/
dialogue.zh: 安靜的禮物，邊邊帶著甜味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My spoon is full again, you take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ spun ɪz fʊl əˈɡɛn ju teɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我的湯匙又裝滿了，你先喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only half, you worked longer at the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli hæf ju wɜrkt ˈlɔŋɡər æt ðə pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 只喝一半就好，你在鍋邊忙比較久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mala side needs a small taste check.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɑlə saɪd nidz ə smɔl teɪst tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 麻辣那邊要試一下味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One tiny ladle, not the whole spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈtaɪni ˈlædəl nɑt ðə hoʊl spun/
dialogue.zh: 一小杓就好，不用整匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still level three, still brave, still soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ˈlɛvəl θri stɪl breɪv stɪl sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 還是三級，還是大膽，還是溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft spice, like a low song.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft spaɪs laɪk ə loʊ sɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 溫柔的辣，像一首低低的歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steam fogged my glasses, now everything glows.
dialogue.phonetic: /stim fɔɡd maɪ ˈɡlæsɪz naʊ ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɡloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 蒸汽把我的眼鏡弄霧了，什麼都在發光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The glowing pot, the glowing room, us too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɡloʊɪŋ pɑt ðə ˈɡloʊɪŋ rum ʌs tu/
dialogue.zh: 發光的鍋、發光的房間，我們也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the lamp down, the glow is enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə læmp daʊn ðə ɡloʊ ɪz ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 把燈調暗一點，鍋光就已經夠亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough, and the broth keeps us warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈnʌf ænd ðə brɔθ kips ʌs wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 夠了，而且湯會讓我們一直暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our pot smells like a long Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər pɑt smɛlz laɪk ə lɔŋ ˈsʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們的鍋聞起來像一個悠長的星期日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A slow Sunday with nothing to finish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sloʊ ˈsʌndeɪ wɪð ˈnʌθɪŋ tu ˈfɪnɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢的星期日，什麼都不用趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the kindest sentence I have heard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈkaɪndst ˈsɛntəns aɪ hæv hɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 這是我聽過最溫柔的一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can rest now, the fire is low.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn rɛst naʊ ðə ˈfaɪər ɪz loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以先歇一下，火轉小了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the mala base lose taste when it rests?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈmɑlə beɪs luz teɪst wɛn ɪt rɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 麻辣鍋底小火靜置會沒味道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, resting makes the numbing taste rounder.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈrɛstɪŋ meɪks ðə ˈnʌmbɪŋ teɪst ˈraʊndər/
dialogue.zh: 不會，靜置反而讓麻味更圓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rounder, softer, like a pillow of soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈraʊndər ˈsɔftər laɪk ə ˈpɪloʊ əv sup/
dialogue.zh: 更圓、更軟，像一枕頭的湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you are writing soup poems at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ju ɑr ˈraɪtɪŋ sup ˈpoʊəmz æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 九點了，你還在寫關於湯的詩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soup poems, then a little nap after.
dialogue.phonetic: /sup ˈpoʊəmz ðɛn ə ˈlɪtəl næp ˈæftər/
dialogue.zh: 寫兩行湯的詩，然後回家小睡一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not say it loud, that is our plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt seɪ ɪt laʊd ðæt ɪz ˈaʊər plæn/
dialogue.zh: 別說太大聲，那正是我們的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next Friday, the tomato side, yes?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ˈfraɪdeɪ ðə təˈmeɪtoʊ saɪd jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 下個星期五來吃番茄鍋，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will come for the tomato broth.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ wɪl kʌm fɔr ðə təˈmeɪtoʊ brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我會為了那鍋番茄湯來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our broth is ready, the meat list is next.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər brɔθ ɪz ˈrɛdi ðə mit lɪst ɪz nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 鍋底準備好了，接下來要點肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will hold the pen, you read the page.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hoʊld ðə pɛn ju rid ðə peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 我來拿筆，你唸那一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One check mark per plate, no rushing.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tʃɛk mɑrk pɜr pleɪt noʊ ˈrʌʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一盤打一個勾，不用趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rushing, the pot will wait all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈrʌʃɪŋ ðə pɑt wɪl weɪt ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不用趕，這鍋可以等我們一整夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us start the meat list, shall we?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs stɑrt ðə mit lɪst ʃæl wi/
dialogue.zh: 我們開始點肉的那一欄，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write two plates of thin beef first.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt tu pleɪts əv θɪn bif fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 先寫兩盤薄牛肉片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the beef slices still on ice?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə bif ˈslaɪsəz stɪl ɑn aɪs/
dialogue.zh: 牛肉片還是冰鎮著的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cut thin, laid on a bed of ice.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kʌt θɪn leɪd ɑn ə bɛd əv aɪs/
dialogue.zh: 對，切得很薄，鋪在冰上保鮮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How thin are the thin beef slices?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ θɪn ɑr ðə θɪn bif ˈslaɪsəz/
dialogue.zh: 那種薄牛肉片到底有多薄？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thin as paper, they curl in the broth.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn æz ˈpeɪpər ðeɪ kɜrl ɪn ðə brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 薄得像紙，一下鍋就捲起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve seconds in the mala, then eat.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈsɛkəndz ɪn ðə ˈmɑlə ðɛn it/
dialogue.zh: 在麻辣湯裡燙十二秒就能吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And dip it once, before it cools.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd dɪp ɪt wʌns bɪˈfɔr ɪt kuls/
dialogue.zh: 趁涼之前先蘸一次醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want lamb with your beef?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt læm wɪð jɔr bif/
dialogue.zh: 你在牛肉之外還要加羊肉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One plate of lamb, rolled like little roses.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pleɪt əv læm roʊld laɪk ˈlɪtəl ˈroʊzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 一盤羊肉，捲成小玫瑰那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They roll lamb so it looks pretty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ roʊl læm soʊ ɪt lʊks ˈprɪti/
dialogue.zh: 他們把羊肉捲起來，看起來很漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pretty and soft, it cooks in one breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɪti ænd sɔft ɪt kʊks ɪn wʌn brɛθ/
dialogue.zh: 漂亮又軟嫩，心裡默數一下就熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about pork belly, just one plate?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt pɔrk ˈbɛli dʒʌst wʌn pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那豬五花呢，就一盤好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pork belly needs longer in the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔrk ˈbɛli nidz ˈlɔŋɡər ɪn ðə pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 豬五花要在鍋裡煮久一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we put it in first, no rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi pʊt ɪt ɪn fɜrst noʊ rʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們先把它下鍋，不著急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan, the belly loves a slow boil.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd plæn ðə ˈbɛli lʌvz ə sloʊ bɔɪl/
dialogue.zh: 好計畫，五花最愛慢慢滾的湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many plates of balls should we get?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni pleɪts əv bɔlz ʃʊd wi ɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 丸子我們該點幾盤？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three kinds, fish, beef, and the shrimp ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri kaɪndz fɪʃ bif ænd ðə ʃrɪmp wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 三種，魚丸、牛肉丸，還有蝦丸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fish balls float when they are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɪʃ bɔlz floʊt wɛn ðeɪ ɑr dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 魚丸浮起來就代表煮熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will watch the float, you watch the beef.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl wɑtʃ ðə floʊt ju wɑtʃ ðə bif/
dialogue.zh: 我看丸子浮不浮，你顧牛肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the beef balls need more time?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə bif bɔlz nid mɔr taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 牛肉丸要煮比較久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Longer than fish balls, they grow bigger.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn fɪʃ bɔlz ðeɪ ɡroʊ ˈbɪɡər/
dialogue.zh: 比魚丸久，它們還會膨大一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bigger balls, smaller bites, that is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪɡər bɔlz ˈsmɔlər baɪts ðæt ɪz fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 丸子變大，咬塊變小，很公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair enough, add one spoon of soup to mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ɪˈnʌf æd wʌn spun əv sup tu maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 也行，幫我的碗加一匙湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shrimp paste comes in a small tube, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃrɪmp peɪst kʌmz ɪn ə smɔl tub raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 蝦漿是用一個小筒裝著的，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we squeeze it into leaf shapes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi skwiz ɪt ˈɪntu lif ʃeɪps/
dialogue.zh: 對，我們把它擠成葉子的形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you shape a leaf with paste?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ʃeɪp ə lif wɪð peɪst/
dialogue.zh: 你能用蝦漿捏出一片葉子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can try, my leaves may look like clouds.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn traɪ maɪ livz meɪ lʊk laɪk klaʊdz/
dialogue.zh: 我試試看，我的葉子可能像雲朵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cloud shaped shrimp is still good shrimp.
dialogue.phonetic: /klaʊd ʃeɪpt ʃrɪmp ɪz stɪl ɡʊd ʃrɪmp/
dialogue.zh: 雲朵形狀的蝦漿還是好蝦漿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will make a whole sky of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl meɪk ə hoʊl skaɪ əv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 那我就來捏出一片天空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tofu puffs drink the broth, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊfu pʌfs drɪŋk ðə brɔθ ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 油豆腐會把湯全部吸進去，你知道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two puffs, then, they fill me fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pʌfs ðɛn ðeɪ fɪl mi fæst/
dialogue.zh: 那就兩塊，它們很容易讓我飽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Frozen tofu or the soft white one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfroʊzən ˈtoʊfu ɔr ðə sɔft waɪt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 要凍豆腐，還是那種軟的白豆腐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The soft one, it shakes on the spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɔft wʌn ɪt ʃeɪks ɑn ðə spun/
dialogue.zh: 軟的那種，放在湯匙上會晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mushroom bundle, the thin white kind, yes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌʃrʊm ˈbʌndəl ðə θɪn waɪt kaɪnd jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 來一束菇，那種細細白白的，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the long thin ones, tied with green string.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə lɔŋ θɪn wʌnz taɪd wɪð ɡrin strɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，那種細長的，還綁著綠色的線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the string off before they go in.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə strɪŋ ɔf bɪˈfɔr ðeɪ ɡoʊ ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 下鍋之前先把那條線拿掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I am not cooking the string.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs aɪ æm nɑt ˈkʊkɪŋ ðə strɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我又不是在煮那條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Napa cabbage, half a plate is plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnæpə ˈkæbɪdʒ hæf ə pleɪt ɪz ˈplɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 大白菜半盤就綽綽有餘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half plate, and it needs only a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf pleɪt ænd ɪt nidz ˈoʊnli ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 半盤就好，它只要燙一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lettuce goes in last, it wilts fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛtɪs ɡoʊz ɪn læst ɪt wɪlts fæst/
dialogue.zh: 萵苣最後再下，它一下就軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wilted lettuce with sesame sauce, heaven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪltɪd ˈlɛtɪs wɪð ˈsɛsəmi sɔs ˈhɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 沾了芝麻醬的軟萵苣，太幸福了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many glass noodles did we write?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ɡlæs ˈnudəlz dɪd wi raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 冬粉我們寫了幾份？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bundles, one for each of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈbʌndəlz wʌn fɔr itʃ əv ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 兩束，我們一人一束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glass noodles turn soft in four minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæs ˈnudəlz tɜrn sɔft ɪn fɔr ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 冬粉四分鐘就會變軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we time them, not guess them.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi taɪm ðɛm nɑt ɡɛs ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們要計時，不要亂猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rice cakes too, the short white ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪs keɪks tu ðə ʃɔrt waɪt wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 也要年糕，那種短短白白的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They get chewy, so we cut them in half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɡɛt ˈtʃui soʊ wi kʌt ðɛm ɪn hæf/
dialogue.zh: 它們會變黏，所以我們切成兩半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the kitchen cut the cakes for us?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈkɪtʃən kʌt ðə keɪks fɔr ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 廚房會幫我們把年糕切開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but she can halve them at the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bʌt ʃi kæn hælv ðɛm æt ðə ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 不會，不過她可以在台邊幫我們切半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Potato slices, thin, so they do not break.
dialogue.phonetic: /pəˈteɪtoʊ ˈslaɪsəz θɪn soʊ ðeɪ du nɑt breɪk/
dialogue.zh: 馬鈴薯片切薄一點就不會碎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thin ones turn soft, thick ones stay hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn wʌnz tɜrn sɔft θɪk wʌnz steɪ hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 薄的會變軟，厚的還是硬的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lotus root, too, with all those holes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊtəs rut tu wɪð ɔl ðoʊz hoʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 也要蓮藕，就是有洞洞的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The holes hold soup, my favorite part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊlz hoʊld sup maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 洞裡會裝滿湯，那是我最愛的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taro, or is it too starchy?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑˈroʊ ɔr ɪz ɪt tu ˈstɑrki/
dialogue.zh: 要芋頭嗎，會不會煮得太粉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taro makes the clear broth cloudy and rich.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑˈroʊ meɪks ðə klɪr brɔθ ˈklaʊdi ænd rɪtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 芋頭會讓清湯變濁又變濃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let it cloud, we have all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ɪt klaʊd wi hæv ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就讓它渾濁吧，我們有一整夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All night, and one more plate of beef.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl naɪt ænd wʌn mɔr pleɪt əv bif/
dialogue.zh: 一整夜，再加一盤牛肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more beef plate, that is your rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr bif pleɪt ðæt ɪz jɔr rul/
dialogue.zh: 再多一盤牛肉，這是你的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My rule, yes, and the note is written.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ rul jɛs ænd ðə noʊt ɪz ˈrɪtn/
dialogue.zh: 對，我的規矩，單子也寫好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read the slip back, do not skip a line.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ðə slɪp bæk du nɑt skɪp ə laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 把點單唸一遍，不要跳行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beef twice, lamb once, pork, balls, greens.
dialogue.phonetic: /bif twaɪs læm wʌns pɔrk bɔlz ɡrinz/
dialogue.zh: 牛肉兩盤、羊肉一盤、豬肉、丸子、青菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Greens is a kind word for cabbage.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrinz ɪz ə kaɪnd wɜrd fɔr ˈkæbɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 用青菜來稱大白菜真有禮貌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cabbage does not mind, it gets soft anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæbɪdʒ dʌz nɑt maɪnd ɪt ɡɛts sɔft ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 白菜不會在意，反正它一定會軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the plates priced by their color?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə pleɪts praɪst baɪ ðɛr ˈkʌlər/
dialogue.zh: 盤子是照顏色來計價嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue is cheap, red costs a little more.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu ɪz tʃip rɛd kɔsts ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 藍盤便宜，紅盤貴一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let us start with blue plates tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ʌs stɑrt wɪð blu pleɪts təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們今晚先拿藍盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue for beef, blue for the fish balls.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu fɔr bif blu fɔr ðə fɪʃ bɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 牛肉用藍盤，魚丸也用藍盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the seafood platter for two people?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈsiˌfud ˈplætər fɔr tu ˈpipəl/
dialogue.zh: 那個海鮮盤是給兩個人吃的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For two, it has shrimp, clams, and squid.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr tu ɪt hæz ʃrɪmp klæmz ænd skwɪd/
dialogue.zh: 兩個人剛好，有蝦子、蛤蜊和魷魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Squid curls tight in the spicy side.
dialogue.phonetic: /skwɪd kɜrlz taɪt ɪn ðə ˈspaɪsi saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 魷魚在辣湯那邊會捲得很緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then two pieces, and we share them warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tu ˈpisəz ænd wi ʃɛr ðɛm wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 那來兩塊，我們趁熱分著吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the clam open when it is ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə klæm ˈoʊpən wɛn ɪt ɪz ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 蛤蜊打開的時候就是熟了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open shell, and it is done, do not wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ʃɛl ænd ɪt ɪz dʌn du nɑt weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 殼一開就熟了，別再等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One raw egg, for the sauce, maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn rɔ ɛɡ fɔr ðə sɔs ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 再來一顆生雞蛋，也許可以拌醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sauce bar has it in a cold cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɔs bɑr hæz ɪt ɪn ə koʊld kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 調料台有，裝在冰冰的小杯裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Egg in the sauce makes every bite smooth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛɡ ɪn ðə sɔs meɪks ˈɛvri baɪt smuð/
dialogue.zh: 醬裡加蛋，每一口都變得滑順。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it cools the beef a little too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪt kuls ðə bif ə ˈlɪtəl tu/
dialogue.zh: 它也能讓牛肉稍微涼一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we add a vegetarian plate?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi æd ə ˌvɛdʒəˈtɛriən pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們要再加一份素食盤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tofu skin, corn, and lots of greens.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈtoʊfu skɪn kɔrn ænd lɑts əv ɡrinz/
dialogue.zh: 好，豆皮、玉米，還有很多青菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tofu skin folds like a little cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊfu skɪn foʊldz laɪk ə ˈlɪtəl klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 豆皮摺起來像一塊小布。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill it with broth, then bite once.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪl ɪt wɪð brɔθ ðɛn baɪt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 讓它包滿湯，然後一口咬下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we write the mushroom on the slip?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi raɪt ðə ˈmʌʃrʊm ɑn ðə slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我們有把香菇寫在單子上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the brown caps, four of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə braʊn kæps fɔr əv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 有，那種茶色菇傘，要四朵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four caps, two per person, that is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr kæps tu pɜr ˈpɜrsən ðæt ɪz fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 四朵，一人兩朵，很公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, and please keep the stems, they chew well.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ænd pliːz kip ðə stɛmz ðeɪ tʃu wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 對，菇軸也留著，很好嚼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the meatballs made in house?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈmitbɔlz meɪd ɪn haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 牛肉丸是店裡自己做的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Made by hand each morning, look there.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪd baɪ hænd itʃ ˈmɔrnɪŋ lʊk ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 每天早上手工做的，你看那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their tray of balls looks like marbles.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr treɪ əv bɔlz lʊks laɪk ˈmɑrbəlz/
dialogue.zh: 他們那盤丸子看起來像彈珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Marbles we can eat, what a good game.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɑrbəlz wi kæn it wʌt ə ɡʊd ɡeɪm/
dialogue.zh: 可以吃的彈珠，多好的遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask if the shrimp were cleaned already.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪf ðə ʃrɪmp wɜr klind ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 問一下蝦子是不是已經處理乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says yes, split down the back already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz jɛs splɪt daʊn ðə bæk ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 她說已經沿著背開好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then they need three minutes, no more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðeɪ nid θri ˈmɪnɪts noʊ mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那它們只要煮三分鐘，別多煮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three, and I will set the little timer.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ænd aɪ wɪl sɛt ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈtaɪmər/
dialogue.zh: 三分鐘，我來設那個小計時器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The order slip is full of small marks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔrdər slɪp ɪz fʊl əv smɔl mɑrks/
dialogue.zh: 點單上已經寫得密密麻麻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full plate, full slip, still room for corn.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl pleɪt fʊl slɪp stɪl rum fɔr kɔrn/
dialogue.zh: 盤子滿、單子滿，還裝得下玉米。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is everything, unless you want more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈɛvriθɪŋ ʌnˈlɛs ju wɑnt mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 這樣就齊了，除非你還想要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is enough, the pot is already singing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪˈnʌf ðə pɑt ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈsɪŋɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 夠了，鍋子已經在唱歌了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Singing pot, full table, happy hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪŋɪŋ pɑt fʊl ˈteɪbəl ˈhæpi hændz/
dialogue.zh: 唱歌的鍋、滿滿的桌子、開心的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy hands, and a first round soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi hændz ænd ə fɜrst raʊnd sun/
dialogue.zh: 開心的手，馬上就能煮第一輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us walk to the sauce bar now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs wɔk tu ðə sɔs bɑr naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在走到調料台那邊吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with two empty bowls in my hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪð tu ˈɛmpi boʊlz ɪn maɪ hændz/
dialogue.zh: 好，我手上已經拿著兩個空碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many jars are on this bar?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni dʒɑrz ɑr ɑn ðɪs bɑr/
dialogue.zh: 這個調料台上有多少個罐子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve jars, and six little ladles.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv dʒɑrz ænd sɪks ˈlɪtəl ˈlædəlz/
dialogue.zh: 十二個醬罐，還有六支小杓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sesame jar is the heavy one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɛsəmi dʒɑr ɪz ðə ˈhɛvi wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 芝麻醬那一罐是特別重的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stir it first, the oil sits on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɜr ɪt fɜrst ði ɔɪl sɪts ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 先攪一下，油都浮在最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One spoon of sesame, is that enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn spun əv ˈsɛsəmi ɪz ðæt ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 一匙芝麻醬夠不夠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two spoons, the paste is very thick.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu spunz ðə peɪst ɪz ˈvɛri θɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我要兩匙，這個醬很濃稠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half a spoon of chili oil, only.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə spun əv ˈtʃɪli ɔɪl ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 辣油只要半匙就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one full spoon for my own bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn fʊl spun fɔr maɪ oʊn boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 我自己的那碗要整整一匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you press the garlic or scoop it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju prɛs ðə ˈɡɑrlɪk ɔr skup ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 蒜泥是用壓的還是用舀的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a press, silver, on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə prɛs ˈsɪlvər ɑn ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 左手邊有一個銀色的壓蒜器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two cloves for me, three if you dare.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kloʊvz fɔr mi θri ɪf ju dɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我加兩瓣蒜，你敢的話三瓣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I dare, garlic is the soul of sauce.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɛr ˈɡɑrlɪk ɪz ðə soʊl əv sɔs/
dialogue.zh: 我敢，蒜就是蘸醬的靈魂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soul, yes, but also a kind of fire.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊl jɛs bʌt ˈɔlsoʊ ə kaɪnd əv ˈfaɪər/
dialogue.zh: 是靈魂，但同時也是一種火。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft fire, mine goes under the sesame.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft ˈfaɪər maɪn ɡoʊz ˈʌndər ðə ˈsɛsəmi/
dialogue.zh: 溫柔的火，我的蒜要埋在芝麻醬下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cilantro, a small handful, torn by hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪˈlæntroʊ ə smɔl ˈhændfʊl tɔrn baɪ hænd/
dialogue.zh: 香菜一小把，用手撕開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Torn, not cut, it smells brighter that way.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɔrn nɑt kʌt ɪt smɛlz ˈbraɪtər ðæt weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 用手撕不用切的，聞起來比較清香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut cilantro is in the second jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt sɪˈlæntroʊ ɪz ɪn ðə ˈsɛkənd dʒɑr/
dialogue.zh: 切好的香菜在第二個罐子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will take the cut kind, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə kʌt kaɪnd θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 我拿切好的那種，省事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scallion rings, green and white, both please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈskæliən rɪŋz ɡrin ænd waɪt boʊθ pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 蔥花，蔥綠蔥白都要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, and peanuts crushed in the brass bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ænd ˈpinʌts krʌʃt ɪn ðə bræs boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 都要，還有銅碗裡壓碎的花生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those peanuts already crushed for us?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðoʊz ˈpinʌts ɔlˈrɛdi krʌʃt fɔr ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 那些花生是已經幫我們壓碎的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half crushed, some pieces stay nice and big.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf krʌʃt sʌm ˈpisəz steɪ naɪs ænd bɪɡ/
dialogue.zh: 只壓一半，有些塊狀還大大留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One spoon of oyster sauce, maybe less.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn spun əv ˈɔɪstər sɔs ˈmeɪbi lɛs/
dialogue.zh: 蠔油一匙，也許再少一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Less, the broth is already very salty.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs ðə brɔθ ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈvɛri ˈsɔlti/
dialogue.zh: 少一點，鍋裡的湯已經很鹹了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Black vinegar, three drops, not a pour.
dialogue.phonetic: /blæk ˈvɪnɪɡər θri drɑps nɑt ə pɔr/
dialogue.zh: 黑醋三滴就好，不能倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drops wake the sauce, a pour buries it.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɑps weɪk ðə sɔs ə pɔr ˈbɛriz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 幾滴會叫醒醬，倒太多會把它埋起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You talk about sauce like a doctor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tɔk əˈbaʊt sɔs laɪk ə ˈdɑktər/
dialogue.zh: 你講蘸醬的樣子像個醫師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A sauce doctor, with a small glass spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sɔs ˈdɑktər wɪð ə smɔl ɡlæs spun/
dialogue.zh: 一位醬料醫師，手裡拿著小玻璃匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that sugar in the tiny dish?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈʃʊɡər ɪn ðə ˈtaɪni dɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那個小碟裡裝的是糖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, just to round the sharp taste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl dʒʌst tu raʊnd ðə ʃɑrp teɪst/
dialogue.zh: 一點點，用來把嗆味修圓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the raw egg in that cold cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə rɔ ɛɡ ɪn ðæt koʊld kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 那冰杯裡的生雞蛋呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only stirred in sauce, never eaten alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈstɜrd ɪn sɔs ˈnɛvər ˈitən əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 只拌進蘸醬裡，絕不會單獨生吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the jar of chopped chilies?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə dʒɑr əv tʃɑpt ˈtʃɪliz/
dialogue.zh: 那切碎辣椒的那一罐呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip it, our mala side has plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪp ɪt ˈaʊər ˈmɑlə saɪd hæz ˈplɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 跳過吧，麻辣那邊已經夠多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is our sauce the same, or different?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈaʊər sɔs ðə seɪm ɔr ˈdɪfərənt/
dialogue.zh: 我們的蘸料一樣嗎，還是不同？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Different, yours runs hot, mine runs creamy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪfərənt jɔrz rʌnz hɑt maɪn rʌnz ˈkrimi/
dialogue.zh: 不一樣，你的偏辣，我的偏奶香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Creamy needs the sesame, hot needs oil.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrimi nidz ðə ˈsɛsəmi hɑt nidz ɔɪl/
dialogue.zh: 要濃潤就加芝麻醬，要辣就加辣油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I need a wipe, my hand is oily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪ nid ə waɪp maɪ hænd ɪz ˈɔɪli/
dialogue.zh: 我還需要一張濕紙，我手上有油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Napkins are stacked under the sauce spoons.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnæpkɪnz ɑr stækt ˈʌndər ðə sɔs spunz/
dialogue.zh: 餐巾紙疊在醬料杓的下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two is plenty, one for each hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɪz ˈplɛnti wʌn fɔr itʃ hænd/
dialogue.zh: 兩張就夠了，每隻手各一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did a drop fall on the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ə drɑp fɔl ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 有一滴滴到台面上了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we wipe it, the bar stays clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi waɪp ɪt ðə bɑr steɪz klin/
dialogue.zh: 對，我們擦掉，調料台要保持乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The next guest will thank us quietly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɛkst ɡɛst wɪl θæŋk ʌs ˈkwaɪətli/
dialogue.zh: 下一位客人會在心裡謝謝我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet thanks, that is our special sauce.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət θæŋks ðæt ɪz ˈaʊər ˈspɛʃəl sɔs/
dialogue.zh: 無聲的謝意，就是我們最特別的蘸料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us carry the bowls back to the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ˈkæri ðə boʊlz bæk tu ðə pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 我們把兩碗醬端到鍋邊吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow steps, the floor is a little wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ stɛps ðə flɔr ɪz ə ˈlɪtəl wɛt/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢走，地板有一點濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set your bowl on the small paper mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt jɔr boʊl ɑn ðə smɔl ˈpeɪpər mæt/
dialogue.zh: 把你的碗放在小紙墊上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mat is under, now the first test dip.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæt ɪz ˈʌndər naʊ ðə fɜrst tɛst dɪp/
dialogue.zh: 墊好了，現在來做第一次試蘸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dip one spoon, hold it up high.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪp wʌn spun hoʊld ɪt ʌp haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 用匙蘸一下，把匙舉高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: High enough, the sauce runs in a thread.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪˈnʌf ðə sɔs rʌnz ɪn ə θrɛd/
dialogue.zh: 夠高了，醬沿著匙流成一條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A thread of sauce, that is the goal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə θrɛd əv sɔs ðæt ɪz ðə ɡoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 醬流成一條細線，那就是目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The goal was dinner, and a little fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡoʊl wʌz ˈdɪnər ænd ə ˈlɪtəl fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 目標就是這頓飯，再加一點好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your sesame looks too thick to dip.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈsɛsəmi lʊks tu θɪk tu dɪp/
dialogue.zh: 你的芝麻醬看起來太稠，蘸不起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A splash of hot broth will fix it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə splæʃ əv hɑt brɔθ wɪl fɪks ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 加一點滾湯就能調開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Broth in sauce, who started that habit?
dialogue.phonetic: /brɔθ ɪn sɔs hu ˈstɑrtɪd ðæt ˈhæbɪt/
dialogue.zh: 醬裡加湯，這個習慣是誰開始的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This table, last winter, with one tired spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈteɪbəl læst ˈwɪntər wɪð wʌn ˈtaɪərd spun/
dialogue.zh: 就是這張桌子，去年冬天，一支累壞的匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One tired spoon, and a rule was born.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈtaɪərd spun ænd ə rul wʌz bɔrn/
dialogue.zh: 一支累壞的匙，就定下一條規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sauce rules, born at this very table.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔs rulz bɔrn æt ðɪs ˈvɛri ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 蘸醬的規矩，就在這張桌上誕生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bowl stays plain sesame only.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn boʊl steɪz pleɪn ˈsɛsəmi ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 其中一碗只放純芝麻醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain is a safe place to rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn ɪz ə seɪf pleɪs tu rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 原味是一個讓舌頭休息的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest the tongue, yes, after level three.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst ðə tʌŋ jɛs ˈæftər ˈlɛvəl θri/
dialogue.zh: 讓舌頭歇一下，畢竟是三級辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And sesame cools like a soft blanket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈsɛsəmi kuls laɪk ə sɔft ˈblæŋkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 芝麻醬蓋下來像一條軟毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we bring enough bowls from the bar?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi brɪŋ ɪˈnʌf boʊlz frʌm ðə bɑr/
dialogue.zh: 我們從調料台拿夠碗了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two for sauce, two empty for the shells.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu fɔr sɔs tu ˈɛmpi fɔr ðə ʃɛlz/
dialogue.zh: 醬料用兩個，另外兩個空碗放蝦殼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good thinking, shells need their own house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ʃɛlz nid ðɛr oʊn haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 想得真好，蝦殼也要有自己的家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their own house, plus one for shrimp heads.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr oʊn haʊs plʌs wʌn fɔr ʃrɪmp hɛdz/
dialogue.zh: 它們自己的碗，另外一個放蝦頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The server sees us, she brings more napkins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɜrvər siz ʌs ʃi brɪŋz mɔr ˈnæpkɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 服務生看見我們，多拿了紙巾過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How kind of her, sauce lives on our hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ kaɪnd əv hɜr sɔs lɪvz ɑn ˈaʊər hændz/
dialogue.zh: 她真好，我們的醬都長在手上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sauce on the sleeve, that is my record.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔs ɑn ðə sliv ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈrɛkərd/
dialogue.zh: 醬又沾到袖子，這是我的新紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your apron saves the shirt, wear it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈeɪprən seɪvz ðə ʃɜrt wɛr ɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 圍裙會救你的襯衫，現在就套上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Apron on, I am ready to dip badly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪprən ɑn aɪ æm ˈrɛdi tu dɪp ˈbædli/
dialogue.zh: 圍裙穿好了，我準備亂蘸一通。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bad dips are brave dips, that is science.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæd dɪps ɑr breɪv dɪps ðæt ɪz ˈsaɪəns/
dialogue.zh: 亂蘸就是勇敢的蘸，這是科學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Science says try the garlic with lamb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaɪəns sɛz traɪ ðə ˈɡɑrlɪk wɪð læm/
dialogue.zh: 科學說蒜泥要配羊肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Science also says sesame loves the fish ball.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaɪəns ˈɔlsoʊ sɛz ˈsɛsəmi lʌvz ðə fɪʃ bɔl/
dialogue.zh: 科學也說芝麻醬最愛魚丸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Match each meat with the right small bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /mætʃ itʃ mit wɪð ðə raɪt smɔl boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 每種肉都配對的那一小碗醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine matches beef, yours matches greens.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ˈmætʃɪz bif jɔrz ˈmætʃɪz ɡrinz/
dialogue.zh: 我的配牛肉，你的配青菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too much garlic for one bowl, do you think?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mʌtʃ ˈɡɑrlɪk fɔr wʌn boʊl du ju θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 你會不會覺得一碗放不下這麼多蒜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half my garlic goes in your bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf maɪ ˈɡɑrlɪk ɡoʊz ɪn jɔr boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 我把一半的蒜，拌進你的碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You always share the loudest flavor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈɔlweɪz ʃɛr ðə ˈlaʊdəst ˈfleɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 你總是分最嗆的那種味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loud flavor, quiet table, that is us.
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd ˈfleɪvər ˈkwaɪət ˈteɪbəl ðæt ɪz ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 味道大聲、桌子安靜，這就是我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us return the spoons to the bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs rɪˈtɜrn ðə spunz tu ðə bɑr/
dialogue.zh: 我們把杓子放回調料台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They keep four clean ones, always enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kip fɔr klin wʌnz ˈɔlweɪz ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 他們一直保持四支乾淨的，都夠用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I used the last clean spoon, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ juzd ðə læst klin spun ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 我把最後一支乾淨的匙用掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is fine, the jar lid is next.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz faɪn ðə dʒɑr lɪd ɪz nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，下一步是蓋好罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lids on, jars closed, bar wiped clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪdz ɑn dʒɑrz kloʊzd bɑr waɪpt klin/
dialogue.zh: 蓋子蓋上、罐子收好、台面擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are finished, and our bowls are art.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr ˈfɪnɪʃt ænd ˈaʊər boʊlz ɑr ɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 我們完成了，兩碗醬像作品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Art we can eat, that is my museum.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑrt wi kæn it ðæt ɪz maɪ mjuˈziəm/
dialogue.zh: 可以吃的藝術，這就是我的美術館。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open till late, and free for two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən tɪl leɪt ænd fri fɔr tu/
dialogue.zh: 開到很晚，兩個人還免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back at the pot, the broth is calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk æt ðə pɑt ðə brɔθ ɪz kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 回到座位，湯正平靜地滾著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calm and ready, the first beef is in.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑm ænd ˈrɛdi ðə fɜrst bif ɪz ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 平靜又準備好，第一盤牛肉下鍋了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve seconds, I am counting very softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈsɛkəndz aɪ æm ˈkaʊntɪŋ ˈvɛri ˈsɔftli/
dialogue.zh: 十二秒，我正在很小聲地數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time is up, lift it, my bowl waits.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm ɪz ʌp lɪft ɪt maɪ boʊl weɪts/
dialogue.zh: 時間到，撈起來吧，我的碗在等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The beef is up, pale pink turning brown.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bif ɪz ʌp peɪl pɪŋk ˈtɜrnɪŋ braʊn/
dialogue.zh: 牛肉撈起來了，粉紅正在變褐色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brown means ready, dip it while it steams.
dialogue.phonetic: /braʊn minz ˈrɛdi dɪp ɪt waɪl ɪt stimz/
dialogue.zh: 變褐就是熟了，趁冒煙時蘸醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One perfect bite, sesame, garlic, a little heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈpɜrfɪkt baɪt ˈsɛsəmi ˈɡɑrlɪk ə ˈlɪtəl hit/
dialogue.zh: 完美的一口，芝麻、蒜、一點辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was the best plan of the night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ðə bɛst plæn əv ðə naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那是今晚最好的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, we practice at our own table.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm wi ˈpræktɪs æt ˈaʊər oʊn ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 下次我們在自家的桌上練習調醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Practice, taste, write it down, keep the recipe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpræktɪs teɪst raɪt ɪt daʊn kip ðə ˈrɛsəpi/
dialogue.zh: 練習、試味道、寫下來，留下配方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a cooking card on the table?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈkʊkɪŋ kɑrd ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 桌上有指示煮多久的小卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it lists times for every plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt lɪsts taɪmz fɔr ˈɛvri pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有，它列著每一盤要煮多久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long for the frozen fish balls?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ fɔr ðə ˈfroʊzən fɪʃ bɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 冷凍魚丸要煮多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes, or when they float high.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnɪts ɔr wɛn ðeɪ floʊt haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘，或是看它們浮得高高的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the beef balls need the same time?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə bif bɔlz nid ðə seɪm taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 牛肉丸也要煮一樣久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little more, they hold more meat inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr ðeɪ hoʊld mɔr mit ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 要再久一點，它裡面肉比較多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the shrimp paste leaves, how long?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ʃrɪmp peɪst livz haʊ lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那蝦漿葉子要煮多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes, they rise with small bubbles.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts ðeɪ raɪz wɪð smɔl ˈbʌbəlz/
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘，它們會跟著小泡浮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the leaves ready when they turn pink?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə livz ˈrɛdi wɛn ðeɪ tɜrn pɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 蝦漿變粉紅就是熟了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pink through, no gray in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪŋk θru noʊ ɡreɪ ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/
dialogue.zh: 要全粉紅，中間不能有灰色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I check without breaking one?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ tʃɛk wɪˈðaʊt ˈbreɪkɪŋ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我怎麼檢查才不會把它弄破？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it gently, it should feel firm.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ɪt ˈdʒɛntli ɪt ʃʊd fil fɜrm/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕壓一下，它應該要有彈性。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Firm like a small pillow, yes?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrm laɪk ə smɔl ˈpɪloʊ jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 像小枕頭那樣有彈性，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly that, my pillow test passed twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt maɪ ˈpɪloʊ tɛst pæst twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 就是那樣，我的枕頭測試過了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the glass noodles, now or later?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ɡlæs ˈnudəlz naʊ ɔr ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 那冬粉呢，現在煮還是等一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Later, or they thicken the whole broth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪtər ɔr ðeɪ ˈθɪkən ðə hoʊl brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 等一下再下，不然整鍋湯會變稠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four minutes for them, from the card?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈmɪnɪts fɔr ðɛm frʌm ðə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 卡片上寫它們四分鐘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four, and stir once so they open.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ænd stɜr wʌns soʊ ðeɪ ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 四分鐘，攪一下讓它們散開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the napa leaves need a long time?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ˈnæpə livz nid ə lɔŋ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 白菜葉要煮很久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty seconds, then they lie down soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti ˈsɛkəndz ðɛn ðeɪ laɪ daʊn sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 四十秒，它們就軟軟地躺下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lying down is their way of saying done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlaɪɪŋ daʊn ɪz ðɛr weɪ əv ˈseɪɪŋ dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 躺平就是它們在說熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it again when I lift them.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt əˈɡɛn wɛn aɪ lɪft ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 等我把它們撈起來時再說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the corn done when the kernels glow?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə kɔrn dʌn wɛn ðə ˈkɜrnəlz ɡloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 玉米粒發亮就是熟了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Corn is sweet at eight good minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔrn ɪz swit æt eɪt ɡʊd ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 煮滿八分鐘的玉米最甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight minutes, I wrote it on my hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈmɪnɪts aɪ roʊt ɪt ɑn maɪ hænd/
dialogue.zh: 八分鐘，我寫在手心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do not read the times from your palm.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz du nɑt rid ðə taɪmz frʌm jɔr pɑm/
dialogue.zh: 拜託，別照著手心讀時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The timer beeps, or do we just count?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaɪmər bips ɔr du wi dʒʌst kaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 計時器會嗶，還是我們自己數？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It beeps, but softly, it is a kind beep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt bips bʌt ˈsɔftli ɪt ɪz ə kaɪnd bip/
dialogue.zh: 會嗶，但很輕，是一種溫柔的嗶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the pot stop boiling with cold plates?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə pɑt stɑp ˈbɔɪlɪŋ wɪð koʊld pleɪts/
dialogue.zh: 加入冰的盤子時，湯會暫停滾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It rests a moment, then returns to work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rɛsts ə ˈmoʊmənt ðɛn rɪˈtɜrnz tu wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 它休息一小下，然後回去工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So wait for the roll before we time.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ weɪt fɔr ðə roʊl bɪˈfɔr wi taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 所以要等湯回滾再開始計時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait for the roll, then start the count.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt fɔr ðə roʊl ðɛn stɑrt ðə kaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 等它回滾，然後開始數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which chopsticks are for the raw beef?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈtʃɑpstɪks ɑr fɔr ðə rɔ bif/
dialogue.zh: 哪一雙筷子是用來夾生牛肉的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The long dark pair, the public chopsticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɔŋ dɑrk pɛr ðə ˈpʌblɪk ˈtʃɑpstɪks/
dialogue.zh: 那雙長長的深色筷，就是公筷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Public ones in, private ones to the mouth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʌblɪk wʌnz ɪn ˈpraɪvət wʌnz tu ðə maʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 公筷下鍋，私筷才進嘴巴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and we rest them on the spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ænd wi rɛst ðɛm ɑn ðə spun/
dialogue.zh: 對，然後讓筷子擱在湯匙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Strainer spoons are best for the balls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstreɪnər spunz ɑr bɛst fɔr ðə bɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 撈丸子用濾網杓最方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift, pause, let the soup run back.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft pɔz lɛt ðə sup rʌn bæk/
dialogue.zh: 撈起、停一下，讓湯流回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want me to cook, or you?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt mi tu kʊk ɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 你想讓我煮，還是由你來煮？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You cook, I will sit and receive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kʊk aɪ wɪl sɪt ænd rɪˈsiv/
dialogue.zh: 你煮，我坐著接就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Receive like a king, with both hands open.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈsiv laɪk ə kɪŋ wɪð boʊθ hændz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 像國王那樣張開兩手接住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both hands, yes, and this bowl is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ hændz jɛs ænd ðɪs boʊl ɪz jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 兩手都接，這一碗先給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this beef still too pink to eat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs bif stɪl tu pɪŋk tu it/
dialogue.zh: 這牛肉還粉紅得不能吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait five more seconds, then it is safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt faɪv mɔr ˈsɛkəndz ðɛn ɪt ɪz seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 再等五秒，那樣就安心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safe, warm, and soft, the three rules.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf wɔrm ænd sɔft ðə θri rulz/
dialogue.zh: 安全、熱、軟，三條原則。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three rules, one spoon, and a patient heart.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri rulz wʌn spun ænd ə ˈpeɪʃənt hɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 三條原則、一支匙，還有一顆耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long for the thin white mushrooms?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ fɔr ðə θɪn waɪt ˈmʌʃrʊmz/
dialogue.zh: 那種細細白白的菇要煮多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety seconds, they shrink into soft threads.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti ˈsɛkəndz ðeɪ ʃrɪŋk ˈɪntu sɔft θrɛdz/
dialogue.zh: 九十秒，它們會縮成軟軟的絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the brown cap take longer still?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə braʊn kæp teɪk ˈlɔŋɡər stɪl/
dialogue.zh: 茶色那朵菇傘要更久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three minutes, the thick ones love time.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈmɪnɪts ðə θɪk wʌnz lʌv taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 三分鐘，厚的就是喜歡時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time is the last secret ingredient here.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm ɪz ðə læst ˈsikrɪt ɪnˈɡridiənt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 時間是這裡最後一樣祕密材料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Secret, simple, and free, like all good times.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsikrɪt ˈsɪmpəl ænd fri laɪk ɔl ɡʊd taɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 祕密、簡單、免費，像所有好時光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tofu puff floating yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈtoʊfu pʌf ˈfloʊtɪŋ jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 油豆腐飄起來了沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, push it under twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt pʊʃ ɪt ˈʌndər twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 還沒，把它壓進湯裡兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pressed, it drinks, then it floats full.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛst ɪt drɪŋks ðɛn ɪt floʊts fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 壓下去它吸湯，然後飽飽地浮起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full of soup, be careful when you bite.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl əv sup bi ˈkɛrfəl wɛn ju baɪt/
dialogue.zh: 裡面全都是湯，咬的時候要小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot soup inside, that is the trap.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt sup ɪnˈsaɪd ðæt ɪz ðə træp/
dialogue.zh: 裡面藏著燙湯，這就是陷阱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A kind trap, bite small and slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kaɪnd træp baɪt smɔl ænd sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 溫柔的陷阱，小口慢慢咬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long for the rice cakes, again?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ fɔr ðə raɪs keɪks əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 年糕要煮多久，再說一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six minutes, or they hug the divider.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmɪnɪts ɔr ðeɪ hʌɡ ðə dɪˈvaɪdər/
dialogue.zh: 六分鐘，不然它們會抱著隔板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hugging cakes, what a sweet little problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhʌɡɪŋ keɪks wʌt ə swit ˈlɪtəl ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 抱在一起的年糕，多可愛的小問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loosen them with the back of a spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlusən ðɛm wɪð ðə bæk əv ə spun/
dialogue.zh: 用湯匙背面把它們推開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the lotus root need much time?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈloʊtəs rut nid mʌtʃ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 蓮藕需要煮很久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four minutes keeps it crisp, six makes soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈmɪnɪts kips ɪt krɪsp sɪks meɪks sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 四分鐘是脆的，六分鐘就綿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crisp for you, soft for me, perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /krɪsp fɔr ju sɔft fɔr mi ˈpɜrfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 你吃脆的、我吃軟的，剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two textures from one pot, clever trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈtɛkstʃərz frʌm wʌn pɑt ˈklɛvər trɪk/
dialogue.zh: 一鍋兩種口感，聰明的小手法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the pot lid off while we cook?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə pɑt lɪd ɔf waɪl wi kʊk/
dialogue.zh: 我們煮的時候鍋蓋要拿掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off for the mala, on for the corn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf fɔr ðə ˈmɑlə ɑn fɔr ðə kɔrn/
dialogue.zh: 麻辣那邊掀開，玉米那邊蓋著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Covering the corn steams it to gold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌvərɪŋ ðə kɔrn stimz ɪt tu ɡoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 蓋著悶玉米，會悶出金色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gold, sweet, and ready when you blink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊld swit ænd ˈrɛdi wɛn ju blɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 金色、甜甜的一眨眼就熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the timer just sound for the beef?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈtaɪmər dʒʌst saʊnd fɔr ðə bif/
dialogue.zh: 計時器剛才是為牛肉響的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that was the mushrooms, not the beef.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðæt wʌz ðə ˈmʌʃrʊmz nɑt ðə bif/
dialogue.zh: 不，剛那聲是菇的，不是牛肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more minute, the beef is patient.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈmɪnɪt ðə bif ɪz ˈpeɪʃənt/
dialogue.zh: 再一分鐘，牛肉很有耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Patient beef, impatient chopsticks, oh dear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪʃənt bif ɪmˈpeɪʃənt ˈtʃɑpstɪks oʊ dɪr/
dialogue.zh: 耐心的牛肉，著急的筷子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not rush, we have the whole evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt rʌʃ wi hæv ðə hoʊl ˈivnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 別急，我們有一整個晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The evening is ours, the pot sets the pace.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈivnɪŋ ɪz ˈaʊərz ðə pɑt sɛts ðə peɪs/
dialogue.zh: 晚上是我們的，節奏交給鍋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A pot is a good clock, softly loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə pɑt ɪz ə ɡʊd klɑk ˈsɔftli laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 鍋子就是好時鐘，輕輕地響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It ticks in bubbles, and we read it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tɪks ɪn ˈbʌbəlz ænd wi rid ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 它用小泡泡滴答，我們讀得懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blow once on that spoon, it is hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /bloʊ wʌns ɑn ðæt spun ɪt ɪz hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 那匙湯吹一下，它很燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blowing, yes, and sipping from the edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbloʊɪŋ jɛs ænd ˈsɪpɪŋ frʌm ði ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 在吹了，還從匙邊小口喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cooler at the edge, smart spoon use.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkulər æt ði ɛdʒ smɑrt spun jus/
dialogue.zh: 匙邊比較涼，很聰明的用法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart is my middle name tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ɪz maɪ ˈmɪdəl neɪm təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚聰明就是我的中間名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does the pork belly still need?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ðə pɔrk ˈbɛli stɪl nid/
dialogue.zh: 豬五花還要煮多久？
