dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six more, the edges are turning clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks mɔr ði ˈɛdʒɪz ɑr ˈtɜrnɪŋ klɪr/
dialogue.zh: 再六分鐘，肥邊已經轉成半透明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clear edges mean the fat has left.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪr ˈɛdʒɪz min ðə fæt hæz lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 邊緣變清，就是油脂跑出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The broth gets richer, so we win.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə brɔθ ɡɛts ˈrɪtʃər soʊ wi wɪn/
dialogue.zh: 湯也變得更濃，是我們賺到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not skim all the fat, leave some.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt skɪm ɔl ðə fæt liv sʌm/
dialogue.zh: 別把油全撇掉，留一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some fat is flavor, the card says so.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm fæt ɪz ˈfleɪvər ðə kɑrd sɛz soʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一點油就是味道，卡上也這樣寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card says the greens go in last.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd sɛz ðə ɡrinz ɡoʊ ɪn læst/
dialogue.zh: 卡片說青菜要最後再下鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Greens at the end, they soak up broth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrinz æt ði ɛnd ðeɪ soʊk ʌp brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 青菜最後下，它們會吸滿湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have we asked how long the clams take?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv wi æskt haʊ lɔŋ ðə klæmz teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我們問過蛤蜊要煮多久了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three minutes, discard any that stay shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈmɪnɪts dɪˈskɑrd ˈɛni ðæt steɪ ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 三分鐘，一直沒開的就丟掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shrimp are pink, but the timer says wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃrɪmp ɑr pɪŋk bʌt ðə ˈtaɪmər sɛz weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 蝦子變粉紅了，但計時器說還得等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pink and timed, that is the real sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪŋk ænd taɪmd ðæt ɪz ðə ril saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 既變了粉紅又煮夠時間，那才是真的熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round two is ready, the broth rolled back.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd tu ɪz ˈrɛdi ðə brɔθ roʊld bæk/
dialogue.zh: 第二輪可以了，湯又滾回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Round two, same plan, we go slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd tu seɪm plæn wi ɡoʊ ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 第二輪，一樣慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow is the secret rule of hot pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ɪz ðə ˈsikrɪt rul əv hɑt pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 慢就是吃火鍋的祕密規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And we are very good at slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wi ɑr ˈvɛri ɡʊd æt sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 而我們最拿手的就是慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Full bowls, quiet pot, what a night.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl boʊlz ˈkwaɪət pɑt wʌt ə naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 碗滿滿、鍋安靜，多好的一晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A good night needs one more thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡʊd naɪt nidz wʌn mɔr θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好夜晚還需要多一樣東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our broth line has dropped a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər brɔθ laɪn hæz drɑpt ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 我們的湯位下降了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Raise your hand, the server sees the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪz jɔr hænd ðə ˈsɜrvər siz ðə pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 舉手示意一下，外場會看到鍋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse us, could the pot have more broth?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz ʌs kʊd ðə pɑt hæv mɔr brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，這鍋可以再加點湯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, mushroom or plain hot broth?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs ˈmʌʃrʊm ɔr pleɪn hɑt brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，要菌菇湯還是一般高湯？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mushroom on the clear side, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌʃrʊm ɑn ðə klɪr saɪd pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 菌菇湯請加在清湯那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the mala side gets plain broth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈmɑlə saɪd ɡɛts pleɪn brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 麻辣那邊就加一般的高湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the extra broth free at this shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ði ˈɛkstrə brɔθ fri æt ðɪs ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 這家店加湯是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free, all night, as many times as you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ɔl naɪt æz ˈmɛni taɪmz æz ju laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 免費，整個晚上想加幾次都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we may need it twice tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi meɪ nid ɪt twaɪs təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們今晚可能要加兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will come back in ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kʌm bæk ɪn tɛn ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我大約十分鐘後再過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, and take your time, no rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ænd teɪk jɔr taɪm noʊ rʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，你慢慢來，不用趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice guests, the pot is easy to read.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ɡɛsts ðə pɑt ɪz ˈizi tu rid/
dialogue.zh: 你們真好，鍋子一眼就看得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She went to the big black kettle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɛnt tu ðə bɪɡ blæk ˈkɛtəl/
dialogue.zh: 她走向那支黑色的大湯壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kettle rides on a small cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɛtəl raɪdz ɑn ə smɔl kɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 湯壺放在一輛小推車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cart just for the broth, how kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kɑrt dʒʌst fɔr ðə brɔθ haʊ kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 專門為湯準備一輛小車，真周到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kind and safe, the kettle is very heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaɪnd ænd seɪf ðə ˈkɛtəl ɪz ˈvɛri ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 貼心又安全，因為那支壺很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we lift the lid while she pours?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi lɪft ðə lɪd waɪl ʃi pɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 她倒湯的時候我們要掀蓋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will hold it, steam makes it hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hoʊld ɪt stim meɪks ɪt hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 我來扶蓋子，蒸汽把它燙熱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use the cloth, do not touch the handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə klɔθ du nɑt tʌtʃ ðə ˈhændəl/
dialogue.zh: 用布墊著，不要直接碰把手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cloth on, now she can come over.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɔθ ɑn naʊ ʃi kæn kʌm ˈoʊvər/
dialogue.zh: 墊好了，她現在可以過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She pours low, near the soup surface.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi pɔrz loʊ nɪr ðə sup ˈsɜrfəs/
dialogue.zh: 她倒得很低，幾乎貼著湯面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low pouring stops the splash on us.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ ˈpɔrɪŋ stɑps ðə splæʃ ɑn ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 倒得低就不會噴到我們身上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the new broth as strong as before?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə nu brɔθ æz strɔŋ əz bɪˈfɔr/
dialogue.zh: 新加的湯跟原來一樣濃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same pot, same kettle, same deep taste.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm pɑt seɪm ˈkɛtəl seɪm dip teɪst/
dialogue.zh: 同一鍋、同一壺，味道一樣濃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, a thin broth would make us sad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ə θɪn brɔθ wʊd meɪk ʌs sæd/
dialogue.zh: 好，湯要變淡我們會覺得可惜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She never adds plain water, only broth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈnɛvər ædz pleɪn ˈwɔtər ˈoʊnli brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 她從不加白水，只加高湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only broth, that is a house rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli brɔθ ðæt ɪz ə haʊs rul/
dialogue.zh: 只加高湯，這是店裡的原則。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: House rules, the reason we keep coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊs rulz ði ˈrizən wi kip ˈkʌmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 店家的原則，是我們一直回來的理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much did the level come up?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dɪd ðə ˈlɛvəl kʌm ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 湯位上升了多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost to the line, the mark is there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst tu ðə laɪn ðə mɑrk ɪz ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 幾乎到那條線，記號就在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a line inside the pot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə laɪn ɪnˈsaɪd ðə pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 鍋子內側有一條線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A thin ring, it shows the safe fill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə θɪn rɪŋ ɪt ʃoʊz ðə seɪf fɪl/
dialogue.zh: 一圈細線，標示安全的水位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safe fill, so nothing jumps out.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf fɪl soʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ dʒʌmps aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 裝到安全線，湯就不會跳出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the lid sits flat again, see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə lɪd sɪts flæt əˈɡɛn si/
dialogue.zh: 蓋子又能平平地蓋回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to a rolling boil, one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk tu ə ˈroʊlɪŋ bɔɪl wʌn ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 再一分鐘就又滾起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rolling means we can drop the noodles.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈroʊlɪŋ minz wi kæn drɑp ðə ˈnudəlz/
dialogue.zh: 一滾我們就可以放冬粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now for the noodles, the pot has room.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ fɔr ðə ˈnudəlz ðə pɑt hæz rum/
dialogue.zh: 現在下冬粉，鍋裡空間夠大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plenty of broth lets them swim and soften.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈplɛnti əv brɔθ lɛts ðɛm swɪm ænd ˈsɔfən/
dialogue.zh: 湯夠多，冬粉才能游動變軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we stir once when they go in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi stɜr wʌns wɛn ðeɪ ɡoʊ ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 下鍋的時候要不要攪一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One stir, and the noodles do not stick.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn stɜr ænd ðə ˈnudəlz du nɑt stɪk/
dialogue.zh: 攪一下，麵就不會黏在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clear side looks hungrier for broth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɪr saɪd lʊks ˈhʌŋɡriər fɔr brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 清湯那邊看起來更需要湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It boils harder, so it drinks more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt bɔɪlz ˈhɑrdər soʊ ɪt drɪŋks mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 它滾得比較凶，所以喝得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next refill on that side, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst riˈfɪl ɑn ðæt saɪd ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那下一次就補那一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will ask her when the line drops.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æsk hɜr wɛn ðə laɪn drɑps/
dialogue.zh: 等水位下降我就請她加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to call her or wave?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid tu kɔl hɜr ɔr weɪv/
dialogue.zh: 我們要開口叫她，還是揮揮手？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small wave, she is watching this corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl weɪv ʃi ɪz ˈwɑtʃɪŋ ðɪs ˈkɔrnər/
dialogue.zh: 揮一下手就好，她一直在看這角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She waves back with the big ladle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi weɪvz bæk wɪð ðə bɪɡ ˈlædəl/
dialogue.zh: 她揮著那支大湯杓回應我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ladle is her friendly flag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlædəl ɪz hɜr ˈfrɛndli flæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 那支湯杓就是她的友誼旗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A flag of broth, my favorite signal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə flæɡ əv brɔθ maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈsɪɡnəl/
dialogue.zh: 一面湯做的旗，是我最愛的訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Signal received, the pot is full again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪɡnəl rɪˈsivd ðə pɑt ɪz fʊl əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 訊號收到，鍋子又滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taste the clear side, has it changed?
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪst ðə klɪr saɪd hæz ɪt tʃeɪndʒd/
dialogue.zh: 試一下清湯，味道有變嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little softer, one more pinch of mushroom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ˈsɔftər wʌn mɔr pɪntʃ əv ˈmʌʃrʊm/
dialogue.zh: 稍微淡了一點，再放一小撮菇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The jar of dried mushrooms is on the bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɑr əv draɪd ˈmʌʃrʊmz ɪz ɑn ðə bɑr/
dialogue.zh: 乾菇那一罐就在調料台上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will go get a pinch, hold the spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ɡoʊ ɡɛt ə pɪntʃ hoʊld ðə spun/
dialogue.zh: 我去拿一小撮，你先拿著匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A pinch more, and the soup is balanced.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə pɪntʃ mɔr ænd ðə sup ɪz ˈbælənst/
dialogue.zh: 再多一小撮，湯就平衡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Balanced, warm, and deep, just like before.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbælənst wɔrm ænd dip dʒʌst laɪk bɪˈfɔr/
dialogue.zh: 平衡、溫熱、濃厚，跟原本一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before the refill it was a bit thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ðə riˈfɪl ɪt wʌz ə bɪt θɪn/
dialogue.zh: 補湯之前有一點淡淡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the mala sings at full voice.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈmɑlə sɪŋz æt fʊl vɔɪs/
dialogue.zh: 現在麻辣那邊唱得很大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Full voice, and we are still calm here.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl vɔɪs ænd wi ɑr stɪl kɑm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 鍋裡聲音很滿，我們這裡依舊安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calm is the rule, the pot does the noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑm ɪz ðə rul ðə pɑt dʌz ðə nɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 安靜是原則，聲音交給鍋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bone broth cooked here all day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə boʊn brɔθ kʊkt hɪr ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 大骨湯是在店裡熬了一整天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six hours, the kitchen says on the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈaʊərz ðə ˈkɪtʃən sɛz ɑn ðə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 六個小時，菜單卡上這樣寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six hours in a pot, that is patient.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈaʊərz ɪn ə pɑt ðæt ɪz ˈpeɪʃənt/
dialogue.zh: 一鍋煮六小時，真有耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Patience we can taste, spoon by spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪʃəns wi kæn teɪst spun baɪ spun/
dialogue.zh: 耐心是喝得出來的，一匙一匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May we have a cup of the clear broth?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ wi hæv ə kʌp əv ðə klɪr brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以要一碗清湯喝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, in the small bowl with scallion.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪn ðə smɔl boʊl wɪð ˈskæliən/
dialogue.zh: 可以，用小碗裝，撒上蔥花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scallion on top makes the bowl perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈskæliən ɑn tɑp meɪks ðə boʊl ˈpɜrfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 蔥花飄在湯面上，這碗就完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bowl came warm, the steam is soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə boʊl keɪm wɔrm ðə stim ɪz sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 碗是溫的，蒸汽也很輕柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sip first, this bowl is like a bath.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪp fɜrst ðɪs boʊl ɪz laɪk ə bæθ/
dialogue.zh: 先小口喝，這碗湯像泡澡一樣暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bath for the tongue, then back to meat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bæθ fɔr ðə tʌŋ ðɛn bæk tu mit/
dialogue.zh: 讓舌頭泡個澡，再回來吃肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The server tops us up without a word.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɜrvər tɑps ʌs ʌp wɪˈðaʊt ə wɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 外場一句話就幫我們補滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She reads the pot, not the people.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ridz ðə pɑt nɑt ðə ˈpipəl/
dialogue.zh: 她讀的是鍋子，不是客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not the people, and yet she is kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ðə ˈpipəl ænd jɛt ʃi ɪz kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 雖然讀的是鍋，她依然溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kindness in broth, served twice already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaɪndnəs ɪn brɔθ sɜrvd twaɪs ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 溫柔在湯裡，已經加了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice is plenty, we are nearly full.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ɪz ˈplɛnti wi ɑr ˈnɪrli fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 兩次就很夠，我們快飽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nearly full, yet the corn still calls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɪrli fʊl jɛt ðə kɔrn stɪl kɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 快飽了，但玉米還在叫我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The corn calls, the rice cakes whisper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɔrn kɔlz ðə raɪs keɪks ˈwɪspər/
dialogue.zh: 玉米在喊，年糕在小聲說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whispering cakes, we will save one piece.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪspərɪŋ keɪks wi wɪl seɪv wʌn pis/
dialogue.zh: 小聲的年糕，我們留一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save it for the very last round.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ɪt fɔr ðə ˈvɛri læst raʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 留到最後一輪再吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last round, fresh broth, and nothing more.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst raʊnd frɛʃ brɔθ ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 最後一輪只加新湯，別的都不加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that soup at the end like dessert?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt sup æt ði ɛnd laɪk dɪˈzɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 最後那碗湯喝起來像甜點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet corn, soft cake, yes, almost dessert.
dialogue.phonetic: /swit kɔrn sɔft keɪk jɛs ˈɔlmoʊst dɪˈzɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 甜玉米、軟年糕，幾乎是甜點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our broth level is perfect right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər brɔθ ˈlɛvəl ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們的湯位現在剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for ten more minutes, then we ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt fɔr tɛn mɔr ˈmɪnɪts ðɛn wi æsk/
dialogue.zh: 還能撐十分鐘，到時再請她加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we owe anything for all this broth?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi oʊ ˈɛniθɪŋ fɔr ɔl ðɪs brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 這些加湯要另外算錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing, it is written on the menu page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪt ɪz ˈrɪtn ɑn ðə ˈmɛnju peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 不用錢，菜單那一頁有寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I will remember this kindness.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ wɪl rɪˈmɛmbər ðɪs ˈkaɪndnəs/
dialogue.zh: 好，我會記得這份體貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Remember the name of the place too.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmɛmbər ðə neɪm əv ðə pleɪs tu/
dialogue.zh: 也把這家店的名字一起記住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pot steams, the night grows long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑt stimz ðə naɪt ɡroʊz lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 鍋子冒著煙，夜變長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long and easy, nobody hurries us.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ ænd ˈizi ˈnoʊbədi ˈhɜriz ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 又長又輕鬆，沒有人催我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody hurries, that is the real luxury.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbədi ˈhɜriz ðæt ɪz ðə ril ˈlʌkʃəri/
dialogue.zh: 沒有人催，才是真正的享受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Luxury in a paper apron and a ladle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌkʃəri ɪn ə ˈpeɪpər ˈeɪprən ænd ə ˈlædəl/
dialogue.zh: 享受就在紙圍裙與湯杓之間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask her for one more bowl of broth.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɜr fɔr wʌn mɔr boʊl əv brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 跟她再要一碗湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more, plus a spoon of corn.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr plʌs ə spun əv kɔrn/
dialogue.zh: 再一碗，她還順手加了一匙玉米。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Corn in my bowl, what a small gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔrn ɪn maɪ boʊl wʌt ə smɔl ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 碗裡有玉米，多小的一份禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small gifts, warm bowls, a quiet room.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ɡɪfts wɔrm boʊlz ə ˈkwaɪət rum/
dialogue.zh: 小禮物、溫的碗、安靜的空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our pot is full, our hands are busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər pɑt ɪz fʊl ˈaʊər hændz ɑr ˈbɪzi/
dialogue.zh: 鍋子滿了，我們的雙手也忙著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Busy and glad, careful with that hot rim.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪzi ænd ɡlæd ˈkɛrfəl wɪð ðæt hɑt rɪm/
dialogue.zh: 忙又快樂，不過滾燙的鍋緣要小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rim is the one thing to watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɪm ɪz ðə wʌn θɪŋ tu wɑtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 鍋緣是唯一要當心的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watched, mostly, but fingers forget sometimes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃt ˈmoʊstli bʌt ˈfɪŋɡərz fərˈɡɛt ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 大部分都有注意，但手指偶爾會忘記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, my finger touched the hot rim.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ maɪ ˈfɪŋɡər tʌtʃt ðə hɑt rɪm/
dialogue.zh: 啊，我的手指碰到燙燙的鍋緣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it under the cold water now.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt ˈʌndər ðə koʊld ˈwɔtər naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 快放到冷水下面沖一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water here is warm, not cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔtər hɪr ɪz wɔrm nɑt koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的水是溫的，不涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get a cup of ice from the bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt ə kʌp əv aɪs frʌm ðə bɑr/
dialogue.zh: 去調料台拿一杯冰塊來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, a small cup of ice, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi ə smɔl kʌp əv aɪs pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，請給我一小杯冰塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the drink or for your finger?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ðə drɪŋk ɔr fɔr jɔr ˈfɪŋɡər/
dialogue.zh: 是要喝的，還是燙到手指了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For my finger, the pot rim bit me.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr maɪ ˈfɪŋɡər ðə pɑt rɪm bɪt mi/
dialogue.zh: 給手指的，鍋緣咬了我一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring ice and a cold wet cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl brɪŋ aɪs ænd ə koʊld wɛt klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 我拿冰塊和一條冰的濕布來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A wet cloth, yes, that helps a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɛt klɔθ jɛs ðæt hɛlps ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 濕布太好了，那樣很有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes on it, no more than that.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ɑn ɪt noʊ mɔr ðæn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 敷十分鐘就好，不要超過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ice bowl came, in a clean small dish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði aɪs boʊl keɪm ɪn ə klin smɔl dɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 冰碗端來了，裝在乾淨的小碟裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dip the finger, count to twenty slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪp ðə ˈfɪŋɡər kaʊnt tu ˈtwɛnti ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 把手指浸進去，慢慢數到二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty, thirty, forty, it stops stinging.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈθɜrti ˈfɔrti ɪt stɑps ˈstɪŋɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 二十、三十、四十，不再刺痛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, keep it there, the heat is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kip ɪt ðɛr ði hit ɪz ɡɔn/
dialogue.zh: 很好，再泡一下，熱氣退了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was only a small burn, really.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz ˈoʊnli ə smɔl bɜrn ˈrɪli/
dialogue.zh: 其實只是很小的一下燙傷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small burns still need cold and calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl bɜrnz stɪl nid koʊld ænd kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 小燙傷也需要冰鎮和安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, calm now, nothing here is late.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kɑm naʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ hɪr ɪz leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，現在很從容，這裡沒有要趕的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pot will wait, the pot always waits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑt wɪl weɪt ðə pɑt ˈɔlweɪz weɪts/
dialogue.zh: 鍋子會等，鍋子總是在等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also a drop of chili oil jumped.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ ə drɑp əv ˈtʃɪli ɔɪl dʒʌmpt/
dialogue.zh: 還有一滴辣油跳了出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On your wrist? Look, a tiny red dot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn jɔr rɪst lʊk ə ˈtaɪni rɛd dɑt/
dialogue.zh: 在你手腕上？你看，一個紅色小點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dot, it tickles more than it hurts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dɑt ɪt ˈtɪkəlz mɔr ðæn ɪt hɜrts/
dialogue.zh: 一個小點，癢多於痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold cloth there too, and one deep breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld klɔθ ðɛr tu ænd wʌn dip brɛθ/
dialogue.zh: 那裡也蓋冷布，再深深吸一口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathed, and now my arm feels cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɛθd ænd naʊ maɪ ɑrm filz kul/
dialogue.zh: 吸完氣了，手臂現在涼涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool is the target, we reached it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul ɪz ðə ˈtɑrɡɪt wi ritʃt ɪt fæst/
dialogue.zh: 目標就是涼，我們很快就達到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not squeeze the little red dot.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt skwiz ðə ˈlɪtəl rɛd dɑt/
dialogue.zh: 不要擠那個紅色的小點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will not, I only lift the cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl nɑt aɪ ˈoʊnli lɪft ðə klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 我不會碰的，我只把布拿起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She brought the ice so quickly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi brɔt ði aɪs soʊ ˈkwɪkli/
dialogue.zh: 她很快就把冰塊拿來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She carries a small tin by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈkæriz ə smɔl tɪn baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 她門邊放著一個小鐵盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tin? For the burns, she said.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tɪn fɔr ðə bɜrnz ʃi sɛd/
dialogue.zh: 鐵盒？她說那是燙傷用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a clean pad and a little gel.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə klin pæd ænd ə ˈlɪtəl dʒɛl/
dialogue.zh: 對，一塊乾淨紗布和一點凝膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gel on the fingertip, cool again.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒɛl ɑn ðə ˈfɪŋɡərˌtɪp kul əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 指尖上了凝膠，又涼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a pad, loose, so it can breathe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə pæd lus soʊ ɪt kæn brið/
dialogue.zh: 再蓋上紗布，鬆一點，讓它透氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loose is good, tight hurts all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /lus ɪz ɡʊd taɪt hɜrts ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 鬆的好，太緊會痛一整晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now your hand rests, I will do the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ jɔr hænd rɛsts aɪ wɪl du ðə pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 現在你的手休息，鍋子交給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You do the pot, I do the watching.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju du ðə pɑt aɪ du ðə ˈwɑtʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你負責鍋，我負責看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watching is work, the timer is mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɑtʃɪŋ ɪz wɜrk ðə ˈtaɪmər ɪz maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 看著也是工作，計時器我來管。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yours the timer, mine the cold bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔrz ðə ˈtaɪmər maɪn ðə koʊld boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 計時器是你的，冷碗是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, and keep that finger out of steam.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil ænd kip ðæt ˈfɪŋɡər aʊt əv stim/
dialogue.zh: 成交，那根手指別伸進蒸汽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out of steam, out of the rim's reach.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt əv stim aʊt əv ðə rɪmz ritʃ/
dialogue.zh: 離蒸汽遠一點，離鍋緣也遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reach with the long chopsticks instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ritʃ wɪð ðə lɔŋ ˈtʃɑpstɪks ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 改用那雙長筷子去夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long chopsticks are heroes at this table.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ ˈtʃɑpstɪks ɑr ˈhɪroʊz æt ðɪs ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 長筷子是這張桌上的英雄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heroes with handles, staying cool in hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɪroʊz wɪð ˈhændəlz ˈsteɪɪŋ kul ɪn hænd/
dialogue.zh: 有長柄的英雄，握在手上不燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hand is dry now, the pad holds.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hænd ɪz draɪ naʊ ðə pæd hoʊldz/
dialogue.zh: 我的手乾了，紗布也固定著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then only the clear side for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn ˈoʊnli ðə klɪr saɪd fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 好，那你就只碰清湯那一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clear side, cooler edge, clever plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɪr saɪd ˈkulər ɛdʒ ˈklɛvər plæn/
dialogue.zh: 清湯那邊鍋緣比較涼，聰明計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever and slow, two things we do well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɛvər ænd sloʊ tu θɪŋz wi du wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 聰明又慢，兩件我們擅長的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need a band on the other hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid ə bænd ɑn ði ˈʌðər hænd/
dialogue.zh: 你另一隻手也要包一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just a spot from the splashing broth.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dʒʌst ə spɑt frʌm ðə ˈsplæʃɪŋ brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 不用，只是被噴出來的湯點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Splashing happens when the pot laughs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsplæʃɪŋ ˈhæpənz wɛn ðə pɑt læfs/
dialogue.zh: 鍋子笑的時候就會噴湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we laugh softly and keep our distance.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi læf ˈsɔftli ænd kip ˈaʊər ˈdɪstəns/
dialogue.zh: 那我們小聲笑，保持距離。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Distance is a kind of care, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪstəns ɪz ə kaɪnd əv kɛr ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 距離也是一種照顧，你知道嗎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Care, distance, ice, and a little time.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɛr ˈdɪstəns aɪs ænd ə ˈlɪtəl taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 照顧、距離、冰塊，還有一點時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does the fingertip feel right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dʌz ðə ˈfɪŋɡərˌtɪp fil raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 指尖現在感覺怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm again, not hot, that is progress.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm əˈɡɛn nɑt hɑt ðæt ɪz ˈprɑɡrɛs/
dialogue.zh: 又變溫了，不燙，這就是進步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Progress deserves one small sipping cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɑɡrɛs dɪˈzɜrvz wʌn smɔl ˈsɪpɪŋ kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 有一點進步，就值得一小杯飲料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plum juice, cold, with no ice inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌm dʒus koʊld wɪð noʊ aɪs ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 酸梅湯，冰的，裡面不必再放冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold plum juice for the tongue today.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld plʌm dʒus fɔr ðə tʌŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天換冰酸梅湯照顧舌頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That soup bit my tongue, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt sup bɪt maɪ tʌŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 那碗湯也咬了我的舌頭一口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A burnt tongue needs three cold sips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɜrnt tʌŋ nidz θri koʊld sɪps/
dialogue.zh: 燙到的舌頭要喝三口涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three sips, and the taste is back.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri sɪps ænd ðə teɪst ɪz bæk/
dialogue.zh: 三口喝完，味道回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Welcome back, taste, we missed you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm bæk teɪst wi mɪst ju/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎回來，味道，我們好想你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It came with the barley tea, gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt keɪm wɪð ðə ˈbɑrli ti ˈdʒɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 它跟著麥茶一起輕輕回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cloth on my hand is warm now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɔθ ɑn maɪ hænd ɪz wɔrm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我手上的布已經變溫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then dip again, the bowl still has ice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn dɪp əˈɡɛn ðə boʊl stɪl hæz aɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那再浸一次，碗裡還有冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ice keeps working while we eat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs kips ˈwɜrkɪŋ waɪl wi it/
dialogue.zh: 冰繼續工作，我們繼續吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Working ice, resting hand, slow night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɜrkɪŋ aɪs ˈrɛstɪŋ hænd sloʊ naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 冰在忙、手在歇，夜很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to stop cooking for now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid tu stɑp ˈkʊkɪŋ fɔr naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在需要先暫停煮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the burner stays low and calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə ˈbɜrnər steɪz loʊ ænd kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 不用，爐子留著小火，很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Low flame, low hands, low voice.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ fleɪm loʊ hændz loʊ vɔɪs/
dialogue.zh: 火小、手放低、聲音也低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three lows and one warm pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri loʊz ænd wʌn wɔrm pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 三個低，再加一鍋暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pad wants one more cold rinse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pæd wɑnts wʌn mɔr koʊld rɪns/
dialogue.zh: 紗布想再被涼水沖一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse it here, over the little bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ɪt hɪr ˈoʊvər ðə ˈlɪtəl boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 就在小碗上方沖一下吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the burn leave a mark yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə bɜrn liv ə mɑrk jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 燙到的地方留下痕跡了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only pink, and pink fades by morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli pɪŋk ænd pɪŋk feɪdz baɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 只是粉紅，到早上就會退。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fades by morning, like a bad dream.
dialogue.phonetic: /feɪdz baɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ laɪk ə bæd drim/
dialogue.zh: 像壞夢一樣，早上就退了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep only the good memories here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kip ˈoʊnli ðə ɡʊd ˈmɛməˌriz hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡我們只留下好的記憶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Memories of sesame, corn, and steam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛməˌriz əv ˈsɛsəmi kɔrn ænd stim/
dialogue.zh: 關於芝麻、玉米和蒸汽的回憶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one careful finger, telling all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn ˈkɛrfəl ˈfɪŋɡər ˈtɛlɪŋ ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 還有一根學會小心的手指。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Telling us to use the strainer spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɛlɪŋ ʌs tu juz ðə ˈstreɪnər spun/
dialogue.zh: 它在提醒我們用濾網杓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strainer in the right hand, always now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstreɪnər ɪn ðə raɪt hænd ˈɔlweɪz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 從現在起，濾網都在右手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the ice water still cold enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ði aɪs ˈwɔtər stɪl koʊld ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 那碗冰水還夠涼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold as a winter window, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld əz ə ˈwɪntər ˈwɪndoʊ jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 像冬天的窗戶一樣涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Winter windows are my favorite cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪntər ˈwɪndoʊz ɑr maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 冬天的窗戶是我最喜歡的涼意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Favorite cold, in a small white bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfeɪvərɪt koʊld ɪn ə smɔl waɪt boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 最喜歡的涼意，裝在小白碗裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The server checks on us once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɜrvər tʃɛks ɑn ʌs wʌns mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 外場又過來看了我們一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She asks with her eyes, no words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æskz wɪð hɜr aɪz noʊ wɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 她用眼睛問，一句話也沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We answer with a smile and a wave.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈænsər wɪð ə smaɪl ænd ə weɪv/
dialogue.zh: 我們用微笑和揮手回答。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All fine, the pot says it for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl faɪn ðə pɑt sɛz ɪt fɔr ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 一切都好，鍋子幫我們說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say thank you later, now the food.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ θæŋk ju ˈleɪtər naʊ ðə fud/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝一下再說，先顧餐點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The food waits, the thanks can wait too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fud weɪts ðə θæŋks kæn weɪt tu/
dialogue.zh: 餐點在等，謝意也可以等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, say it now, she is still here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ seɪ ɪt naʊ ʃi ɪz stɪl hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 不，現在就說，她還在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for the ice and the care.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɔr ði aɪs ænd ðə kɛr/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的冰塊，還有你的細心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She nods and wipes the table edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi nɑdz ænd waɪps ðə ˈteɪbəl ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 她點點頭，擦了一下桌緣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A drop of broth fell from my bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə drɑp əv brɔθ fɛl frʌm maɪ boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 有一滴湯從我的碗裡掉下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is nothing, the cloth takes it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ ðə klɔθ teɪks ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，布一擦就乾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing at all, and our hands are clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ æt ɔl ænd ˈaʊər hændz ɑr klin/
dialogue.zh: 什麼都沒有留下，手也乾淨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean hands, padded finger, back to soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin hændz ˈpædɪd ˈfɪŋɡər bæk tu sup/
dialogue.zh: 手乾淨了、手指包好了，回到湯邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back to soup, slowly, with both eyes open.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk tu sup ˈsloʊli wɪð boʊθ aɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 回到鍋邊，慢慢來，眼睛張大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eyes open, pot calm, night still young.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪz ˈoʊpən pɑt kɑm naɪt stɪl jʌŋ/
dialogue.zh: 眼睛張著、鍋子安靜、夜還早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Young enough for dessert and a bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʌŋ ɪˈnʌf fɔr dɪˈzɜrt ænd ə bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 還早得可以吃甜點、看帳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pot is almost a quiet soup now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑt ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst ə ˈkwaɪət sup naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 鍋子現在幾乎只剩清淡的湯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quiet soup, and a full plate of shells.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkwaɪət sup ænd ə fʊl pleɪt əv ʃɛlz/
dialogue.zh: 安靜的湯，旁邊還有一盤蝦殼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we order dessert at this hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ˈɔrdər dɪˈzɜrt æt ðɪs ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 這個時間還想點甜點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One shaved ice, split into two bowls.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ʃeɪvd aɪs splɪt ˈɪntu tu boʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 一份剉冰，分成兩碗吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shaved ice with peanuts on top?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪvd aɪs wɪð ˈpinʌts ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 剉冰上面要放花生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and a spoon of plum syrup.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ə spun əv plʌm ˈsɪrəp/
dialogue.zh: 要，再來一匙酸梅糖漿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dessert card shows mango too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði dɪˈzɜrt kɑrd ʃoʊz ˈmæŋoʊ tu/
dialogue.zh: 甜點卡上還有芒果口味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mango next time, tonight is plum night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmæŋoʊ nɛkst taɪm təˈnaɪt ɪz plʌm naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 芒果留給下次，今晚是梅子的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two spoons came with the shaved ice.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu spunz keɪm wɪð ðə ʃeɪvd aɪs/
dialogue.zh: 剉冰附了兩支小匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One spoon each, no fighting tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn spun itʃ noʊ ˈfɪtɪŋ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一人一支，今晚不用搶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweet, cold, quiet, that is the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /swit koʊld ˈkwaɪət ðæt ɪz ði ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 甜甜、冷冷、安靜，就是結尾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The end of the pot, not of the tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛnd əv ðə pɑt nɑt əv ðə ti/
dialogue.zh: 這是鍋子的結尾，不是茶的結尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More tea, and then we ask for the bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr ti ænd ðɛn wi æsk fɔr ðə bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 再添點茶，然後我們請他們結帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The teapot waits beside your elbow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈtiˌpɑt weɪts bɪˈsaɪd jɔr ˈɛlboʊ/
dialogue.zh: 茶壺就在你手肘旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hot pot bill, please, no hurry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɑt pɑt bɪl pliːz noʊ ˈhɜri/
dialogue.zh: 火鍋的帳請拿過來，不用急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, one pot and two drinks.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz wʌn pɑt ænd tu drɪŋks/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，一鍋加兩杯飲料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pot base, and that is the split one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pɑt beɪs ænd ðæt ɪz ðə splɪt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 一份鍋底，就是那個鴛鴦鍋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one split pot for two people.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn splɪt pɑt fɔr tu ˈpipəl/
dialogue.zh: 對，一鍋鴛鴦鍋給兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the pot price per person, or per table?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə pɑt praɪs pɜr ˈpɜrsən ɔr pɜr ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 鍋底是按人算，還是按桌算？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Per pot, so the bill stays very simple.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɜr pɑt soʊ ðə bɪl steɪz ˈvɛri ˈsɪmpəl/
dialogue.zh: 按鍋算，所以帳單很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two drinks, one barley and one plum.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu drɪŋks wʌn ˈbɑrli ænd wʌn plʌm/
dialogue.zh: 兩杯飲料，一杯麥茶、一杯酸梅湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The barley tea is free with the pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɑrli ti ɪz fri wɪð ðə pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 麥茶是跟著鍋底送的，免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free tea, that is honest pricing.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ti ðæt ɪz ˈɑnəst ˈpraɪsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 茶免費，這是很老實的定價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honest, and it is written on the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəst ænd ɪt ɪz ˈrɪtn ɑn ðə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 老實，而且桌上卡片也有寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for the extra blue plates?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ fɔr ði ˈɛkstrə blu pleɪts/
dialogue.zh: 多點的那些藍盤多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue plates are counted by their color.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu pleɪts ɑr ˈkaʊntɪd baɪ ðɛr ˈkʌlər/
dialogue.zh: 藍盤就是照顏色來計算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten blue, six red, and two green.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn blu sɪks rɛd ænd tu ɡrin/
dialogue.zh: 藍色十盤、紅色六盤、綠色兩盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She counted them twice, at the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈkaʊntɪd ðɛm twaɪs æt ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 她在桌邊數了兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counted plates, no guessing on the bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɪd pleɪts noʊ ˈɡɛsɪŋ ɑn ðə bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 盤子數過了，帳單不用猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the dessert is one line on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə dɪˈzɜrt ɪz wʌn laɪn ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 甜點就是最上面那一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this total for two people only?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ˈtoʊtəl fɔr tu ˈpipəl ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 這個總額只是兩個人的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two people, one pot, all the broth.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpipəl wʌn pɑt ɔl ðə brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 兩個人、一鍋，還有那些湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All the broth included, what a deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ðə brɔθ ɪnˈkludɪd wʌt ə dil/
dialogue.zh: 加湯全部免費，真划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A deal, and no service charge here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dil ænd noʊ ˈsɜrvɪs tʃɑrdʒ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 划算，而且這裡不收服務費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tip jar by the cash register?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə tɪp dʒɑr baɪ ðə kæʃ ˈrɛdʒɪstər/
dialogue.zh: 小費罐在收銀台旁邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small glass one, right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə smɔl ɡlæs wʌn raɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 在，一個小玻璃罐，就擺在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will leave something in the jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl liv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪn ðə dʒɑr/
dialogue.zh: 我們要放一點錢進罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the ice, the broth, the kind eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ði aɪs ðə brɔθ ðə kaɪnd aɪz/
dialogue.zh: 為了冰塊、加湯，還有那份細心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card or cash, what do you prefer?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd ɔr kæʃ wʌt du ju priˈfɜr/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡或用現金，你喜歡哪一種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card is easier, the machine is right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd ɪz ˈiziər ðə məˈʃin ɪz raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡比較方便，機器就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap, beep, done, the easiest dance.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp bip dʌn ði ˈiziəst dæns/
dialogue.zh: 碰一下、嗶一聲、好了，最簡單的舞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quiet little payment dance, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkwaɪət ˈlɪtəl ˈpeɪmənt dæns jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 一支安靜又小小的付錢舞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want a paper receipt too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt ə ˈpeɪpər rɪˈsit tu/
dialogue.zh: 你也要一張紙本收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will keep it in my book.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ wɪl kip ɪt ɪn maɪ bʊk/
dialogue.zh: 要，我把它夾在我的本子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A receipt book, like a tiny library.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɪˈsit bʊk laɪk ə ˈtaɪni ˈlaɪˌbɛri/
dialogue.zh: 收據本，像一個小小的圖書館。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A library of warm Friday nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlaɪˌbɛri əv wɔrm ˈfraɪdeɪ naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 一座溫暖星期五夜晚的圖書館。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we buy one noodle pack to go?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi baɪ wʌn ˈnudəl pæk tu ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以買一包乾冬粉帶走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two packs, and one jar of sesame paste.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pæks ænd wʌn dʒɑr əv ˈsɛsəmi peɪst/
dialogue.zh: 兩包冬粉，再加一罐芝麻醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sesame at home, that is a project.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛsəmi æt hoʊm ðæt ɪz ə ˈprɑdʒɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 在家調芝麻醬，那是一項計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small project for a rainy Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl ˈprɑdʒɛkt fɔr ə ˈreɪni ˈsʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一個下雨星期天的小小計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The apron goes back, thank you very much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈeɪprən ɡoʊz bæk θæŋk ju ˈvɛri mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 圍裙還你們，非常感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, the paper ones are ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ nid ðə ˈpeɪpər wʌnz ɑr ˈaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 不用還，紙圍裙本來就是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free aprons, free tea, free broth.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈeɪprənz fri ti fri brɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 免費圍裙、免費茶、免費湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three frees, and one happy bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri friz ænd wʌn ˈhæpi bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 三個免費，加一張開心的帳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our things, our coats, and we go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər θɪŋz ˈaʊər koʊts ænd wi ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們的東西、外套，然後出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coat first, then the door, then home.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊt fɜrst ðɛn ðə dɔr ðɛn hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 先穿外套，再到門邊，然後回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hostess says good night by name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhoʊstɪs sɛz ɡʊd naɪt baɪ neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 外場姑娘喊著名字說晚安。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She always remembers the Friday couple.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈɔlweɪz rɪˈmɛmbərz ðə ˈfraɪdeɪ ˈkʌpəl/
dialogue.zh: 她總是記得這對星期五的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The Friday couple, that is our title.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfraɪdeɪ ˈkʌpəl ðæt ɪz ˈaʊər ˈtaɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 星期五的一對，這是我們的頭銜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A title, a number, and a next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaɪtəl ə ˈnʌmbər ænd ə nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 一個頭銜、一個號碼，還有下一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our ticket tonight was forty-two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈtɪkɪt təˈnaɪt wʌz ˈfɔrti tu/
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚的號碼牌是四十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, it is a lucky number now.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt ɪt ɪz ə ˈlʌki ˈnʌmbər naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 留著吧，它現在是我們的幸運號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold air outside, warm hands inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ɛr ˌaʊtˈsaɪd wɔrm hændz ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 外面是冷空氣，雙手還是暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm from the broth, staying warm now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm frʌm ðə brɔθ ˈsteɪɪŋ wɔrm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 被湯暖過，現在還是一直暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sleeve still smells like sesame.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sliv stɪl smɛlz laɪk ˈsɛsəmi/
dialogue.zh: 我袖子上還有芝麻醬的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, and the hair tie stayed.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu ænd ðə hɛr taɪ steɪd/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，髮圈也還留在手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steam taught my hair a new curl.
dialogue.phonetic: /stim tɔt maɪ hɛr ə nu kɜrl/
dialogue.zh: 蒸汽把我的頭髮燙出新捲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hot pot curl, very fashionable.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hɑt pɑt kɜrl ˈvɛri ˈfæʃənəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 火鍋捲，還挺時髦的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fashionable and hungry again by ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæʃənəbəl ænd ˈhʌŋɡri əˈɡɛn baɪ tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 很時髦，而且十點又餓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not by ten, we are too full.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt baɪ tɛn wi ɑr tu fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 十點不會餓，我們吃得太飽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Full, sleepy, and walking slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl ˈslipi ænd ˈwɔkɪŋ sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 飽、睏，走路也慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow steps home, the pot still humming.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ stɛps hoʊm ðə pɑt stɪl ˈhʌmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢走回家，鍋子還在心裡哼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Humming in my ears, like a song.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhʌmɪŋ ɪn maɪ ɪrz laɪk ə sɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 在我耳朵裡哼著，像一首歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A broth song, short and warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə brɔθ sɔŋ ʃɔrt ænd wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 一首鍋湯的歌，短短的、暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next Friday, tomato and mushroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ˈfraɪdeɪ təˈmeɪtoʊ ænd ˈmʌʃrʊm/
dialogue.zh: 下個星期五吃番茄和菌菇？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomato, mushroom, and no mala.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmeɪtoʊ ˈmʌʃrʊm ænd noʊ ˈmɑlə/
dialogue.zh: 番茄、菌菇，這次不麻辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No mala, our tongues deserve a rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈmɑlə ˈaʊər tʌŋɡz dɪˈzɜrv ə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 不吃麻辣，我們的舌頭該休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We deserve a quiet table too.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi dɪˈzɜrv ə ˈkwaɪət ˈteɪbəl tu/
dialogue.zh: 我們也該再要一張安靜的桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will ask for the corner again.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl æsk fɔr ðə ˈkɔrnər əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我們還會要那個角落位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the same server, if she is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə seɪm ˈsɜrvər ɪf ʃi ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 還有同一位外場，如果她有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Book it now, the page is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊk ɪt naʊ ðə peɪdʒ ɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 現在就訂，預約頁面還開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Booked for eight, two seats, corner note.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊkt fɔr eɪt tu sits ˈkɔrnər noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 訂八點、兩個位子，註明角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A corner note, that is very clever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkɔrnər noʊt ðæt ɪz ˈvɛri ˈklɛvər/
dialogue.zh: 註明角落，這招很聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We thought of it together, you and me.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi θɔt əv ɪt təˈɡɛðər ju ænd mi/
dialogue.zh: 這是我們一起想到的，你和我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The street lamp looks soft tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə strit læmp lʊks sɔft təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 街上的路燈今晚看起來很柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft light, warm windows, closed shops.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft laɪt wɔrm ˈwɪndoʊz kloʊzd ʃɑps/
dialogue.zh: 軟軟的燈、溫暖的窗、關門的店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our hot pot shop is still bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər hɑt pɑt ʃɑp ɪz stɪl braɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們那家火鍋店還亮著燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bright until the last table leaves.
dialogue.phonetic: /braɪt ʌnˈtɪl ðə læst ˈteɪbəl livz/
dialogue.zh: 亮到最後一桌離開為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We were the last table, almost.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɜr ðə læst ˈteɪbəl ˈɔlmoʊst/
dialogue.zh: 我們幾乎就是最後一桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost last, and never in a rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst læst ænd ˈnɛvər ɪn ə rʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 幾乎最後，卻從容不迫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home soon, kettle off, lights low.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊm sun ˈkɛtəl ɔf laɪts loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一下就到家，關火、燈轉暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lights low, and the day is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪts loʊ ænd ðə deɪ ɪz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 燈轉暗，今天就這樣結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done with plates, done with counting.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn wɪð pleɪts dʌn wɪð ˈkaʊntɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 盤子收了，數也數完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the warmth is left with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə wɔrmθ ɪz lɛft wɪð ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 只有暖意留在我們身上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warmth, sleep, and a quiet bed now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrmθ slip ænd ə ˈkwaɪət bɛd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 暖意、睡意，還有安靜的床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well, my hot pot company.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl maɪ hɑt pɑt ˈkʌmpəni/
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，我一起吃鍋的夥伴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, and save me a seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt ænd seɪv mi ə sit/
dialogue.zh: 晚安，幫我先留一個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The corner one, with the warm lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔrnər wʌn wɪð ðə wɔrm læmp/
dialogue.zh: 留那個角落的，有燈的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The corner, the pot, and tomorrow's plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔrnər ðə pɑt ænd təˈmɑroʊz plæn/
dialogue.zh: 角落、火鍋，還有明天的規畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow sleeps, tonight we are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ slips təˈnaɪt wi ɑr dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 明天先睡，今晚已經圓滿。
